title: CIFNet: An Analytic Neural Learning Framework for Efficient and Calibrated Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) in deep neural networks is conventionally framed as an iterative gradient-based optimization problem, incurring high computational cost, hyperparameter sensitivity, and risk of catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we demonstrate that when leveraging frozen pre-trained representations, CIL can be solved as a sequence of deterministic, closed-form classifier adaptations without backpropagation or iterative convergence. We propose CIFNet, an analytic neural learning framework built upon Regularised Recursive Least-Squares (RRLS). CIFNet updates classifier weights via an exact, closed-form ridge-regression solution operating in a stationary embedding space. To counteract the structural initialisation bias that arises when newly expanded output neurons are introduced without exposure to past-class evidence, CIFNet incorporates a lightweight calibration buffer in latent space alongside density-aware oversampling, ensuring globally balanced decision boundaries without raw image storage or gradient updates. Extensive evaluations across CIFAR-100, ImageNet-100, and CORe50 show that CIFNet achieves predictive accuracy competitive with iterative CIL baselines while maintaining strictly monotonic, smooth learning trajectories free from intermediate performance collapse. Furthermore, by replacing epoch-wise backpropagation with closed-form moment accumulation, CIFNet achieves up to 20$\times$ reduction in energy consumption. These findings establish calibrated analytic learning as an efficient, stable, and mathematically grounded paradigm for continual adaptation in neural networks.

AI.title_translation: CIFNet：用于高效且校准的类增量学习的解析神经网络学习框架
AI.tldr: CIFNet利用预训练特征和正则化递归最小二乘法（RRLS），将类增量学习简化为无梯度反向传播的闭式解求解，大幅降低能耗并消除灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 传统的类增量学习（CIL）依赖基于梯度的迭代优化，导致高计算成本、超参数敏感性以及灾难性遗忘风险。
AI.method: 提出了 CIFNet 框架，建立在正则化递归最小二乘法（RRLS）之上。在冻结预训练表示的前提下，通过平稳嵌入空间中的准确岭回归闭式解更新分类器权重，无需反向传播；同时在潜在空间中引入轻量级校准缓冲区与密度感知过采样，消除新扩展神经元的结构初始化偏差，无需存储原始图像。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-100、ImageNet-100 和 CORe50 数据集上的实验表明，CIFNet 取得了与传统迭代式 CIL 基线相当的预测准确率，同时保持了严格单调平滑的学习轨迹，并将能耗降低了高达 20 倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，经过校准的解析学习能够作为神经网络持续适应（类增量学习）的一种高效、稳定且具备严密数学基础的全新范式。
AI.translation: 深度神经网络中的类增量学习（CIL）传统上被构建为基于梯度的迭代优化问题，这带来了高昂的计算成本、超参数敏感性以及灾难性遗忘的风险。在这项工作中，我们证明了在利用冻结的预训练表示时，CIL可以被解决为一门确定性的、闭式解的分类器适应序列，而无需反向传播或迭代收敛。我们提出了CIFNet，一种构建在正则化递归最小二乘法（RRLS）之上的解析神经网络学习框架。CIFNet通过在平稳嵌入空间中运行的准确闭式岭回归解更新分类器权重。为了抵消在引入未经历过去类别证据的新扩展输出神经元时产生的结构初始化偏差，CIFNet在潜在空间中集成了轻量级校准缓冲区以及密度感知过采样，在不存储原始图像或进行梯度更新的情况下确保了全局平衡的决策边界。在CIFAR-100、ImageNet-100和CORe50上的广泛评估表明，CIFNet取得了与迭代式CIL基线相当的预测准确率，同时保持了严格单调、平滑且无中间性能崩溃的学习轨迹。此外，通过将按epoch进行的反向传播替换为闭式矩累加，CIFNet实现了高达20倍的能耗降低。这些发现确立了校准解析学习作为神经网络持续适应的一种高效、稳定且具数学根基的范式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CIFNet，一种针对类增量学习（CIL）的解析神经网络学习框架。CIFNet利用冻结的预训练特征，通过正则化递归最小二乘法（RRLS）直接求解分类器权重的确定性闭式解，无需反向传播。此外，它利用潜在空间校准缓冲区和密度感知过采样克服了新神经元的初始化偏差。实验验证了 CIFNet 在极大降低能耗（最高20倍）的同时，实现了与传统迭代方法相当的精度和更平滑稳定的学习轨迹。
AI.keywords: 类增量学习, 解析学习, 递归最小二乘法, 灾难性遗忘, 闭式解
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将增量学习重构为基于正则化递归最小二乘法（RRLS）的闭式解求解问题，彻底摒弃了基于梯度的反向传播迭代，极大地降低了计算与能源消耗（高达20倍），同时消除了灾难性遗忘与性能崩溃。潜在空间校准机制巧妙解决了新类神经元的初始化偏差问题。其潜在局限在于依赖高质量的预训练特征，在表征能力不足的场景下性能上限可能受限。

title: Comparing RAG and GraphRAG for Page-Level Retrieval Question Answering on a Math Textbook
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show promise as educational aids but often lack alignment with specific course materials. We investigate Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and GraphRAG for page-level question answering on an undergraduate mathematics textbook. Using a curated dataset of 477 question-answer pairs, each tied to a specific textbook page, we compare five embedding-based RAG models, a BM25 baseline, and GraphRAG across two metrics: retrieval accuracy (whether the correct page is retrieved) and answer quality (F1 score). Our results show that embedding-based RAG outperforms GraphRAG for page-level retrieval, with voyage-3-large achieving 99.4% accuracy at top-10 (bootstrap 95% CI for top-1: [.644, .728]). BM25 proves a strong baseline, outperforming several embedding models. Error analysis reveals that 63.3% of top-1 failures retrieve same-chapter content, suggesting pedagogical relevance even in failure cases. GraphRAG retrieves excessive context (~47K tokens vs. ~3.7K for RAG), reducing generation quality. We further replicate key experiments using an open-source local LLM (Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), finding that RAG benefits are proportionally larger for weaker models (+39% vs. +16% relative F1 improvement), an important result for cost-sensitive educational deployments. These findings inform the design of AI tutoring systems that reference specific textbook pages.

AI.title_translation: 在数学教材上针对页面级检索问答对比RAG与GraphRAG
AI.tldr: 在数学教材的页面级问答中，传统RAG在准确率、回答质量和Token开销上均优于GraphRAG，且RAG对能力较弱的本地模型性能提升更显著。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在教育辅助方面前景广阔，但往往缺乏与特定课程材料（如教材具体页面）的精准对齐。需要评估不同检索增强技术（RAG与GraphRAG）在教材页面级问答中的表现。
AI.method: 构建包含477个与本科数学教材具体页面绑定的问答对数据集；对比5种基于嵌入的RAG模型、BM25基线及GraphRAG；评估指标为检索准确率（Top-k页面检索）和回答质量（F1分数）；并使用开源本地大模型（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）复现关键实验。
AI.result: 基于嵌入的RAG在页面级检索上显著优于GraphRAG，其中voyage-3-large在Top-10准确率达99.4%。BM25作为基线表现强劲，超越多个嵌入模型。GraphRAG检索了过多上下文（~47K tokens vs RAG ~3.7K tokens），降低了回答质量。63.3%的Top-1检索失败案例能检索到同章节内容。使用弱模型时，RAG带来的相对F1提升更大（+39% vs +16%）。
AI.conclusion: 在引用特定教材页面的AI导师系统设计中，传统的基于嵌入的RAG在页面级检索问答上优于GraphRAG，具备更高的检索准确率、更少Token开销和更高的生成质量；且RAG对弱模型的性能提升尤为显著。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）作为教学辅助工具展现出应用前景，但往往缺乏与特定课程材料的对齐。我们研究了检索增强生成（RAG）和GraphRAG在本科数学教材页面级问答中的应用。基于一个包含477个与特定教材页面挂钩的精选问答对数据集，我们在检索准确率（是否检索到正确页面）和回答质量（F1分数）两个指标上，对比了5种基于嵌入的RAG模型、一个BM25基线以及GraphRAG。我们的结果表明，基于嵌入的RAG在页面级检索方面优于GraphRAG，其中voyage-3-large在Top-10准确率上达到了99.4%（Top-1自助法95%置信区间为[.644, .728]）。BM25被证明是一个强基线，表现优于多个嵌入模型。错误分析显示，63.3%的Top-1检索失败案例检索到了同一章节的内容，表明即使在失败情况下也具有教学相关性。GraphRAG检索了过多的上下文（约4.7万个Token，而RAG约为3700个Token），从而降低了生成质量。我们进一步使用开源本地大模型（Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）复现了关键实验，发现RAG带来的收益对于较弱的模型在比例上更大（相对F1提升为+39% vs +16%），这对于成本敏感型教育部署而言是一个重要结果。这些发现为引用具体教材页面的AI导师系统的设计提供了参考。
AI.summary: 本文在本科数学教材页面级问答任务上比较了传统嵌入式RAG、BM25和GraphRAG。结果表明，传统嵌入式RAG在准确率和上下文效率上均优于GraphRAG，且BM25表现强劲。此外，实验证明RAG对较弱的开源本地大模型提升更加显著，为低成本教育AI导师系统的设计提供了重要参考。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成 (RAG), GraphRAG, 页面级问答, 教育AI, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于针对教育场景中极具实用价值的“教材页面级问答”任务，系统比较了最近热门的GraphRAG与传统RAG的优劣，打破了GraphRAG在所有场景下均优于传统RAG的迷思。研究结果表明GraphRAG可能引入过多冗余上下文，而传统RAG结合强检索模型或BM25即能实现高效检索。此外，研究探索了RAG对弱模型的显著提升作用，对成本敏感的本地教育AI部署具有重要指导意义。局限性在于研究仅基于单本本科数学教材，其结论在其他学科或非结构化文档上的泛化性仍需进一步验证。

title: Understanding User Experiences of Computer Use Agents: Design Space and Opportunities for Building Agent UX Prototypes
summary: Computer use agents (or "agents") are generative AI that automates actions within user interfaces from user commands. Current research focuses on training and evaluating the underlying models, leaving these agents' user experience (UX) understudied. We conducted two studies to understand the design space of agent UX (RQ1) and the support required to prototype it (RQ2). First, we develop a taxonomy of design considerations for agent UX, comprising 21 subcategories of UX considerations. Then, through a requirements elicitation study with 12 participants---including six agent experts---we identify five Activities and six Desired Capabilities needed in tools prototyping agent UX. Informed by these results, we created AgentUXlab, a design probe that enables developers to design agents with different UX approaches for a website and evaluate those experiences by executing prototypes in a browser. From a user study with 14 participants, we elucidate tooling insights and derive design implications for agent UX prototyping tools.

AI.title_translation: 理解计算机使用智能体的用户体验：构建智能体 UX 原型设计的设计空间与机遇
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了计算机使用智能体的用户体验设计空间，提出了 UX 设计分类法并开发了 AgentUXlab 原型探针，总结了智能体 UX 原型工具的设计启示。
AI.motivation: 目前关于计算机使用智能体的研究大多聚焦于底层模型的训练与评估，而对这类智能体的用户体验（UX）缺乏系统深入的研究。
AI.method: 1. 构建分类法：开发包含 21 个子类别的智能体 UX 设计考量分类体系；2. 需求引出研究：与 12 名参与者（含 6 名智能体专家）进行研究，梳理原型工具的需求；3. 工具设计与实验：开发设计探针 AgentUXlab，并在 14 名参与者的用户研究中评估和评估智能体 UX 原型设计。
AI.result: 1. 建立了包含 21 个子类别的智能体 UX 设计考量分类法；2. 总结出智能体 UX 原型工具所需的 5 项活动和 6 项期望能力；3. 开发了 AgentUXlab 原型工具并提炼出智能体 UX 原型设计工具的设计启示。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了智能体 UX 原型工具的构建洞察，并导出了未来设计与开发智能体 UX 原型工具的设计启示。
AI.translation: 计算机使用智能体（或“智能体”）是一种生成式人工智能，能够根据用户命令自动在用户界面内执行操作。当前研究主要集中在训练和评估底层模型上，使得这些智能体的用户体验（UX）缺乏深入研究。我们进行了两项研究，旨在理解智能体 UX 的设计空间（RQ1）以及原型化这些体验所需的支撑（RQ2）。首先，我们开发了一套智能体 UX 设计考量分类法，包含 21 个 UX 考量子类别。随后，通过对 12 名参与者（包含 6 名智能体专家）开展的需求引出研究，我们确定了智能体 UX 原型设计工具中所需的 5 项活动和 6 项期望能力。受这些结果启发，我们创建了 AgentUXlab——一个设计探针，使开发者能够为网站设计采用不同 UX 方法的智能体，并通过在浏览器中运行原型来评估这些体验。通过包含 14 名参与者的用户研究，我们阐明了工具方面的洞察，并推导出智能体 UX 原型设计工具的设计启示。
AI.summary: 本研究围绕计算机使用智能体的用户体验（UX）展开，揭示了其设计空间与原型工具的需求。研究团队首先构建了涵盖 21 个子类别的 UX 设计分类法，接着通过专家与用户的需求引出研究，明确了原型工具需具备的活动与能力。在此基础上开发的 AgentUXlab 探针工具支持开发者在浏览器中构建并评估不同 UX 策略的智能体，最终为未来的智能体 UX 原型工具开发提供了系统的设计启示。
AI.keywords: 计算机使用智能体, 用户体验, 原型工具设计, 设计空间, 人机交互
AI.comments: 该研究切中当前生成式 AI 智能体（Agent）研究中的关键痛点：大多数现有工作偏重模型性能与算法优化，而忽视了最终用户的实际交互体验（UX）。本文的创新点在于提出了系统的 UX 设计分类法，并开发了探针工具 AgentUXlab 来实证探究原型设计工具的需求，为未来的 HCI（人机交互）与 AI Agent 原型开发工具建设奠定了坚实基础。局限性在于用户研究样本量相对有限，且探针工具可能主要基于 Web 场景。

title: Contrastive Weak-to-strong Generalization
summary: Weak-to-strong generalization provides a promising paradigm for scaling large language models (LLMs) by training stronger models on samples from aligned weaker ones, without requiring human feedback or explicit reward modeling. However, its robustness and generalization are hindered by the noise and biases in weak-model outputs, which limit its applicability in practice. To address this challenge, we leverage implicit rewards, which approximate explicit rewards through log-likelihood ratios, and reveal their structural equivalence with Contrastive Decoding (CD), a decoding strategy shown to reduce noise in LLM generation. Building on this connection, we propose Contrastive Weak-to-Strong Generalization (ConG), a framework that employs contrastive decoding between pre- and post-alignment weak models to generate higher-quality samples. This approach enables more reliable capability transfer, denoising, and improved robustness, substantially mitigating the limitations of traditional weak-to-strong methods. Empirical results across different model families confirm consistent improvements, demonstrating the generality and effectiveness of ConG. Taken together, our findings highlight the potential of ConG to advance weak-to-strong generalization and provide a promising pathway toward AGI.

AI.tldr: 提出 ConG 框架，通过利用对齐前后的弱模型进行对比解码生成高质量样本，有效消除弱模型输出的噪声与偏见，提升弱到强泛化的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 弱到强泛化（Weak-to-strong generalization）旨在利用较弱模型生成的样本训练更强的模型，但在实践中，弱模型输出中存在的噪声和偏见严重损害了训练的鲁棒性和泛化效果。
AI.method: 研究首先证明了基于对数似然比的隐式奖励与对比解码（Contrastive Decoding）在结构上的等价性；在此基础上提出了 ConG（Contrastive Weak-to-Strong Generalization）框架，利用对齐前和对齐后的弱模型之间进行对比解码，生成更高质量、低噪声的训练样本。
AI.result: 跨不同模型系列的实证结果表明，ConG 带来了持续且显著的性能提升，证实了该框架在去噪、鲁棒性和能力迁移方面的通用性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: ConG 能够有效克服传统弱到强泛化方法的局限性，提供更可靠的能力迁移和去噪效果，为推进弱到强泛化技术以及实现通用人工智能（AGI）探索了一条切实可行的路线。
AI.translation: 弱到强泛化通过在无须人类反馈或显式奖励建模的情况下，利用对齐后的较弱模型生成的样本训练较强模型，为扩展大语言模型（LLM）提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，其鲁棒性和泛化能力受到了弱模型输出中的噪声和偏见的阻碍，限制了其在实际中的应用。为了解决这一挑战，我们利用了通过对数似然比近似显式奖励的隐式奖励，并揭示了它们与对比解码（CD，一种被证明可减少 LLM 生成噪声的解码策略）在结构上的等价性。基于这种联系，我们提出了对比式弱到强泛化（ConG）框架，该框架在对齐前后的弱模型之间采用对比解码来生成更高质量的样本。这种方法实现了更可靠的能力迁移、去噪以及增强的鲁棒性，大幅缓解了传统弱到强方法的局限性。在不同模型系列上的实证结果证实了持续的提升，展示了 ConG 的通用性和有效性。总的来说，我们的发现突出了 ConG 在推进弱到强泛化方面的潜力，并为迈向 AGI 提供了有前景的途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Contrastive Weak-to-Strong Generalization (ConG) 框架，旨在解决弱到强泛化中弱模型输出带有噪声和偏见的问题。作者揭示了隐式奖励与对比解码之间的结构等价性，并通过在对齐前后的弱模型之间应用对比解码来生成高质量样本。实验证明，ConG 显著改善了能力迁移与去噪能力，大幅提升了弱到强泛化的鲁棒性和通用性。
AI.keywords: Weak-to-strong generalization, Contrastive decoding, Implicit rewards, AI alignment, Large language models
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将对比解码（Contrastive Decoding）与弱到强泛化相结合，并通过理论推导揭示了隐式奖励与对比解码之间的结构等价性。这一发现不仅在理论上建立了二者的联系，更在实践中通过利用对齐前后的弱模型进行对比，有效消除了弱模型输出中的噪声和偏见，显著提升了能力迁移的可靠性，对解决超级对齐和模型自我提升问题具有重要价值。

title: VisRAG2.0: Mitigating Visual Hallucinations via Evidence-Guided Multi-Image Reasoning in Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VRAG) has emerged as a promising paradigm for equipping Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with external visual evidence, enabling them to go beyond parametric knowledge when answering visually grounded questions. However, in such multi-image settings, VLMs still often suffer from visual hallucinations and struggle to accurately identify the question-relevant evidence needed for reliable reasoning. Existing methods usually lack an explicit cross-image evidence collection process, and also provide limited credit assignment when jointly optimizing perception and reasoning. To address this issue, we propose EVisRAG, an evidence-guided visual retrieval-augmented framework for multi-image reasoning. EVisRAG first observes the retrieved images, records question-relevant visual evidence from each image, and then performs reasoning and answer generation based on the aggregated evidence. We further introduce RS-GRPO, which aligns reward signals with token spans from different stages, improving training stability and strengthening the joint optimization of evidence localization and reasoning. Experiments on multiple visual question answering benchmarks show that EVisRAG consistently outperforms the backbone VLM by an average of about 19\%, while substantially reducing visual hallucinations. These results demonstrate that explicit evidence collection and scoped reward design are effective for improving visual grounding and reasoning reliability in multi-image settings. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/VisRAG

AI.title_translation: VisRAG2.0：在视觉检索增强生成中通过证据引导的多图推理缓解视觉幻觉
AI.tldr: EVisRAG通过显式提取跨图视觉证据并结合阶段性奖励对齐算法（RS-GRPO），有效减少了多图VRAG场景下的视觉幻觉，将模型性能提升了约19%。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉检索增强生成（VRAG）在多图设置下容易产生视觉幻觉，且缺乏显式的跨图证据提取机制，同时在联合优化感知与推理时难以进行精准的信用分配。
AI.method: 提出了EVisRAG框架，首先检索并观察图像，记录每张图像中与问题相关的显式视觉证据，再基于聚合的证据进行推理与答案生成；同时引入RS-GRPO方法，将奖励信号与不同推理阶段的Token片段精准对齐，以提高训练稳定性并增强证据定位与推理的联合优化。
AI.result: 在多个视觉问答（VQA）基准上的实验表明，EVisRAG相比骨干VLM模型平均性能提升了约19%，同时显著减少了视觉幻觉现象。
AI.conclusion: 显式的证据收集机制和范围限定的奖励设计能够有效增强多图像场景下的视觉定位能力与推理可靠性，大幅减少视觉幻觉。
AI.translation: 视觉检索增强生成（VRAG）已成为一种有前景的范式，它为视觉语言模型（VLM）配备外部视觉证据，使其在回答基于视觉的问题时能够超越参数知识。然而，在多图设置下，VLM仍经常遭受视觉幻觉的困扰，并难以准确识别可靠推理所需的问题相关证据。现有方法通常缺乏显式的跨图证据收集过程，并且在联合优化感知和推理时提供的信用分配有限。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了EVisRAG，一种用于多图推理的证据引导的视觉检索增强框架。EVisRAG首先观察检索到的图像，记录每张图像中与问题相关的视觉证据，然后基于聚合的证据进行推理和答案生成。我们进一步引入了RS-GRPO，它将奖励信号与来自不同阶段的token片段对齐，从而提高训练稳定性并加强证据定位与推理的联合优化。在多个视觉问答基准上的实验表明，EVisRAG比骨干VLM一致地平均提升了约19%，同时大幅减少了视觉幻觉。这些结果表明，显式的证据收集和作用域奖励设计对于在多图设置中改善视觉接地和推理可靠性是有效的。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/OpenBMB/VisRAG 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对多图视觉检索增强生成中的视觉幻觉与证据定位难题，提出了EVisRAG框架和RS-GRPO优化方法。EVisRAG通过显式收集并聚合多图证据进行推理，结合阶段性奖励机制提高了感知与推理联合优化的稳定性，显著提升了视觉问答的准确性和可靠性。
AI.keywords: 视觉检索增强生成, 视觉幻觉, 多图推理, 证据引导, 强化学习
AI.comments: 本论文创新性地解决了多图视觉检索增强生成（VRAG）中普遍存在的视觉幻觉和跨图证据定位难题。其核心贡献在于引入了显式的多图证据收集机制以及针对不同阶段Token片段的RS-GRPO奖励分配优化方法，在多个基准测试上取得了显著的性能提升（平均提升约19%），具有很强的实用价值和学术推动力。

title: On the Design and Evaluation of Human-centered Explainable AI Systems: A Systematic Review and Taxonomy
summary: As AI becomes more common in everyday living, there is an increasing demand for intelligent systems that are both performant and understandable. Explainable AI (XAI) systems aim to provide comprehensible explanations of decisions and predictions. At present, however, evaluation processes are rather technical and not sufficiently focused on the needs of human users. Consequently, evaluation studies involving human users can serve as a valuable guide for conducting user studies. This paper presents a comprehensive review of 65 user studies evaluating XAI systems across different domains and application contexts. As a guideline for XAI developers, we provide a holistic overview of the properties of XAI systems and evaluation metrics focused on human users (human-centered). We propose objectives for the human-centered design (design goals) of XAI systems. To incorporate users' specific characteristics, design goals are adapted to users with different levels of AI expertise (AI novices and data experts). In this regard, we provide an extension to existing XAI evaluation and design frameworks. The first part of our results includes the analysis of XAI system characteristics. An important finding is the distinction between the core system and the XAI explanation, which together form the whole system. Further results include the distinction of evaluation metrics into affection towards the system, cognition, usability, interpretability, and explanation metrics. Furthermore, the users, along with their specific characteristics and behavior, can be assessed. For AI novices, the relevant extended design goals include responsible use, acceptance, and usability. For data experts, the focus is performance-oriented and includes human-AI collaboration and system and user task performance.

AI.title_translation: 以人为中心的可解释人工智能系统的设计与评估：系统综述与分类法
AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了65项XAI用户研究，提出了以人为中心的XAI设计目标与评估指标分类法，并针对AI新手和数据专家给出了定制化设计指南。
AI.motivation: 当前的XAI评估流程偏向技术化，缺乏对人类用户实际需求的关注，亟需以人为中心的评估体系和设计指南来指导用户研究与系统开发。
AI.method: 对65项跨领域和应用场景评估XAI系统的用户研究进行了系统综述，构建了XAI系统特性与评估指标分类法，并针对不同AI专业水平（AI新手与数据专家）的用户扩展了设计目标和框架。
AI.result: 区分了核心系统与XAI解释；将以人为中心的评估指标划分为系统情感、认知、可用性、可解释性及解释指标；提出了针对AI新手（负责任使用、接受度、可用性）和数据专家（性能、人机协同、任务表现）的差异化设计目标。
AI.conclusion: 论文扩展了现有的XAI评估与设计框架，为开发人员设计和评估以人为中心的可解释AI系统提供了全面且具可操作性的指导原则和分类法。
AI.translation: 随着人工智能在日常生活中变得日益普及，对兼具高性能和高可理解性的智能系统的需求不断增加。可解释人工智能（XAI）系统旨在为其决策和预测提供易于理解的解释。然而目前，评估过程偏向技术化，未能充分关注人类用户的需求。因此，涉及人类用户的评估研究可以为开展用户研究提供有价值的指导。本文对65项在不同领域和应用背景下评估XAI系统的用户研究进行了全面综述。作为XAI开发人员的指南，我们全面概述了XAI系统的特性以及关注人类用户（以人为中心）的评估指标。我们提出了XAI系统以人为中心设计（设计目标）的目标。为了纳入用户的具体特征，设计目标针对具有不同AI专业知识水平的用户（AI新手和数据专家）进行了调整。在这方面，我们对现有的XAI评估和设计框架进行了扩展。我们结果的第一部分包括对XAI系统特征的分析。一个重要发现是区分了核心系统和XAI解释，两者共同构成了整个系统。进一步的结果包括将评估指标划分为对系统的情感、认知、可用性、可解释性和解释指标。此外，还可以评估用户及其具体特征和行为。对于AI新手，相关的扩展设计目标包括负责任的使用、接受度和可用性。对于数据专家，重点则是面向性能的，包括人机协作以及系统和用户任务绩效。
AI.summary: 本文通过对65项XAI用户研究的系统综述，梳理了XAI系统特性，建立了以人为中心的评估指标体系，并针对不同AI专业知识水平的用户提出了差异化的设计目标，扩展了现有的XAI设计与评估框架。
AI.keywords: 可解释人工智能, 以人为中心的设计, 系统综述, 用户评估, 分类法
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于超越了纯技术层面的评估，从“以人为中心”的视角梳理了65项用户研究，将系统拆解为核心系统与解释机制，并针对AI新手与数据专家提出了差异化的设计目标。其重要性在于为XAI开发者构建和评估系统提供了系统化的指南；局限性在于分析完全基于已有的文献综述，其分类法可能随着未来新型交互模式和大模型XAI的发展而需要持续更新。

title: $M^2PO$: Multi-Perspective Multi-Pair Preference Optimization for Machine Translation
summary: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human preferences is pivotal for Machine Translation (MT), yet current approaches are often hindered by misleading reward signals. Our analysis reveals that prevailing Quality Estimation (QE) models exhibit a systematic blind spot toward partial errors, specifically partial hallucinations and omissions, often favoring superficially fluent but unfaithful translations. To address this issue, we propose $M^2PO$ (Multi-Perspective Multi-Pair Preference Optimization), a data-centric framework for preference optimization in machine translation. First, to correct the bias toward fluency, $M^2PO$ uses a dual-perspective mechanism that decouples semantic fidelity from fluency and prioritizes faithfulness through a curriculum strategy. Second, after correcting this bias, partial errors fall between perfect and severely incorrect translations, making them difficult to learn through standard best-versus-worst comparisons. We therefore introduce a multi-pair objective that leverages the full candidate list to capture these fine-grained error signals. Experiments on WMT23, WMT24, and FLORES-200 show that $M^2PO$ enables a 9B model to outperform leading open-source baselines and achieve parity with proprietary models such as GPT-4o and Gemini-2.0-Flash, demonstrating strong potential for efficient and high-fidelity LLM-based translation. Our code and dataset will be released.

AI.title_translation: $M^2PO$：面向机器翻译的多视角多对偏好优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了 $M^2PO$ 框架，通过解耦忠实度与流畅度并引入多对偏好优化目标，解决了偏好对齐中对局部错误的盲区问题，使 9B 模型实现了媲美 GPT-4o 的翻译性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的偏好对齐方法常受到误导性奖励信号的阻碍。质量评估（QE）模型对局部错误（如局部幻觉和遗漏）存在系统性盲区，倾向于偏好表面流畅但不够忠实的翻译，且传统的最优与最差对比难以学习这些细粒度错误。
AI.method: 提出了 $M^2PO$（多视角多对偏好优化）框架：1. 双视角机制：将语义忠实度与流畅度解耦，并利用课程学习策略优先保障忠实度；2. 多对优化目标：利用完整的候选翻译列表进行多对比较，从而捕获介于完美与严重错误之间的细粒度局部错误信号。
AI.result: 在 WMT23、WMT24 和 FLORES-200 基准测试中的实验表明，$M^2PO$ 使得 9B 参数规模的模型超越了领先的开源基线，并达到了与 GPT-4o 和 Gemini-2.0-Flash 等顶尖专有模型相当的翻译质量。
AI.conclusion: $M^2PO$ 能够有效消除偏好优化中的流畅度偏见并捕捉细粒度翻译错误，为构建高效且高忠实度的基于大语言模型的机器翻译系统提供了强有力的技术路径。
AI.translation: 将大语言模型（LLM）与人类偏好对齐对机器翻译（MT）至关重要，但当前方法常受到误导性奖励信号的阻碍。我们的分析表明，主流的质量评估（QE）模型对局部错误（特别是局部幻觉和遗漏）表现出系统性盲区，往往偏好表面流畅但并不忠实的翻译。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了 $M^2PO$（多视角多对偏好优化），这是一个用于机器翻译偏好优化的以数据为中心的新框架。首先，为了纠正对流畅度的偏见，$M^2PO$ 采用了双视角机制，将语义忠实度与流畅度解耦，并通过课程策略优先考虑忠实度。其次，在纠正该偏见后，局部错误介于完美翻译和严重错误翻译之间，使得标准的最优与最差比较方法难以学习这些错误。因此，我们引入了多对优化目标，利用完整的候选列表来捕获这些细粒度的错误信号。在 WMT23、WMT24 和 FLORES-200 上的实验表明，$M^2PO$ 使得一个 9B 模型超越了领先的开源基线，并达到了与 GPT-4o 和 Gemini-2.0-Flash 等专有模型相当的水平，展示了高效且高忠实度基于 LLM 翻译的巨大潜力。我们的代码和数据集将被开源。
AI.summary: 本文针对大语言模型机器翻译偏好优化中容易偏向“表面流畅但缺乏忠实度”的问题，提出了 $M^2PO$ 框架。该框架通过双视角机制解耦语义忠实度与流畅度，并结合多对比较目标捕获细粒度的局部错误信号。实验表明，基于 $M^2PO$ 优化的 9B 模型在多个机器翻译数据集上达到了媲美顶级商业模型的性能。
AI.keywords: 机器翻译, 偏好优化, 大语言模型, 语义忠实度, 质量评估
AI.comments: 该论文指出了机器翻译偏好优化中一个关键问题：质量评估模型往往过度偏好表面流畅但存在局部幻觉或遗漏的翻译。针对这一痛点，作者提出的双视角解耦与多对偏好比较方法非常具有创新性与实用性。实验结果表明仅 9B 规模的模型即可媲美 GPT-4o 等顶尖专有模型，展示了极高的效率与实用价值。潜在局限在于该方法依赖于多样化候选翻译列表的生成质量。

title: Eliciting Truthful Feedback for Preference-Based Learning via the VCG Mechanism
summary: We study resource allocation problems in which a central planner allocates resources among strategic agents with private cost functions in order to minimize a social cost, defined as an aggregate of the agents' costs. This setting poses two main challenges: (i) the agents' cost functions may be unknown to them or difficult to specify explicitly, and (ii) agents may misreport their costs strategically. To address these challenges, we propose an algorithm that combines preference-based learning with Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) payments to incentivize truthful reporting. Our algorithm selects informative preference queries via D-optimal design, estimates cost parameters through maximum likelihood, and computes VCG allocations and payments based on these estimates. In a one-shot setting, we prove that the mechanism is approximately truthful, individually rational, and efficient up to an error of $\tilde{\mathcal O}(K^{-1/2})$ for $K$ preference queries per agent. In an online setting, these guarantees hold asymptotically with sublinear regret at a rate of $\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{2/3})$ after $T$ rounds. Finally, we validate our approach through a numerical case study on demand response in local electricity markets.

AI.title_translation: 通过VCG机制激发基于偏好学习的真实反馈
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将基于偏好学习与VCG机制结合的新算法，能在智能体成本函数未知且具策略性的情况下，有效激发真实反馈并实现近似最优的资源分配。
AI.motivation: 在中央规划者分配资源以最小化社会成本的设定中，面临两大挑战：（1）智能体的私有成本函数可能自身未知或难以明确指定；（2）智能体可能策略性地虚报成本。
AI.method: 提出了结合偏好学习与VCG支付机制的算法：通过D-最佳设计选择信息丰富的偏好查询，采用最大似然估计估计成本参数，并基于估计出的参数计算VCG资源分配和支付金额。
AI.result: 在单次设定中，对于每位智能体进行 $K$ 次偏好查询，该机制可达到 $\tilde{\mathcal O}(K^{-1/2})$ 误差范围内的近似真实性、个人合理性和高效性；在在线设定中，经过 $T$ 轮后能实现 $\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{2/3})$ 的次线性遗憾；并在局部电力市场需求响应的数值案例研究中验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了将偏好学习与机制设计结合的可行性，能够在智能体仅能提供偏好反馈且存在策略性行为的复杂环境下，实现接近最优的资源分配与真实激励。
AI.translation: 我们研究了中央规划者在具有私有成本函数的策略性智能体之间分配资源，以最小化由智能体成本聚合构成的社会成本的资源分配问题。该设定面临两大主要挑战：（i）智能体的成本函数对其自身可能是未知的或难以明确指定；（ii）智能体可能会策略性地虚报其成本。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种将基于偏好的学习与Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) 支付相结合的算法，以激励真实报告。我们的算法通过D-最佳设计选择具有信息量的偏好查询，通过最大似然估计成本参数，并基于这些估计值计算VCG分配和支付。在单次设定中，我们证明了对于每位智能体的 $K$ 次偏好查询，该机制在 $\tilde{\mathcal O}(K^{-1/2})$ 的误差范围内是近似真实的、个人合理的和高效的。在在线设定中，这些保证在 $T$ 轮后以 $\tilde{\mathcal O}(T^{2/3})$ 的次线性遗憾渐进成立。最后，我们通过局部电力市场需求响应的数值案例研究验证了我们的方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对智能体成本函数未知且存在策略性虚报的资源分配问题，提出了一种结合D-最佳设计偏好查询、最大似然参数估计与VCG支付机制的新算法。该机制在单次与在线设定下均具备坚实的理论保证（近似真实性、个人合理性与高效率/次线性遗憾），并在电力市场需求响应场景中验证了可行性。
AI.keywords: 偏好学习, VCG机制, 机制设计, 资源分配, 真实性机制
AI.comments: 本论文将偏好学习与机制设计（VCG机制）巧妙结合，解决了智能体对自身成本函数不确定以及可能策略性虚报的两大痛点。理论保证完备，兼顾单次与在线设定的近似真实性、个人合理性和高效性，具有较高的学术创新性与实用价值。局限性在于其可能依赖于偏好模型的具体参数化假设，且在大规模在线场景下的计算复杂度有待进一步考量。

title: Long-Term PM2.5 Forecasting Using a DTW-Enhanced CNN-GRU Model
comments: This manuscript is being withdrawn because the authors have identified issues that require substantial revision before the results can be considered reliable. We request withdrawal while these issues are addressed
summary: Reliable long-term forecasting of PM2.5 concentrations is critical for public health early-warning systems, yet existing deep learning approaches struggle to maintain prediction stability beyond 48 hours, especially in cities with sparse monitoring networks. This paper presents a deep learning framework that combines Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) for intelligent station similarity selection with a CNN-GRU architecture to enable extended-horizon PM2.5 forecasting in Isfahan, Iran, a city characterized by complex pollution dynamics and limited monitoring coverage. Unlike existing approaches that rely on computationally intensive transformer models or external simulation tools, our method integrates three key innovations: (i) DTW-based historical sampling to identify similar pollution patterns across peer stations, (ii) a lightweight CNN-GRU architecture augmented with meteorological features, and (iii) a scalable design optimized for sparse networks. Experimental validation using multi-year hourly data from eight monitoring stations demonstrates superior performance compared to state-of-the-art deep learning methods, achieving R2 = 0.91 for 24-hour forecasts. Notably, this is the first study to demonstrate stable 10-day PM2.5 forecasting (R2 = 0.73 at 240 hours) without performance degradation, addressing critical early-warning system requirements. The framework's computational efficiency and independence from external tools make it particularly suitable for deployment in resource-constrained urban environments.
comment: This manuscript is being withdrawn because the authors have identified issues that require substantial revision before the results can be considered reliable. We request withdrawal while these issues are addressed

AI.title_translation: 基于DTW增强型CNN-GRU模型的PM2.5长周期预测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了结合DTW与轻量化CNN-GRU的深度学习框架，成功在稀疏监测网络下实现了稳定长达10天（240小时）的PM2.5长周期准确预测。
AI.motivation: PM2.5浓度的可靠长周期预测对公共卫生预警至关重要，但现有深度学习方法在预测时效超过48小时后稳定性显著下降，尤其是在监测网络稀疏、污染动态复杂的城市中难以有效应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种融合DTW与CNN-GRU的深度学习框架：首先利用DTW进行历史采样，识别对等站点间相似的污染模式；其次构建结合气象特征的轻量化CNN-GRU架构提取时空特征；最后采用针对稀疏监测网络优化的可扩展设计。
AI.result: 在伊朗伊斯法罕8个监测站的多年份逐小时数据验证中，该模型表现优于现有最新方法，24小时预测的R²达到0.91；并首次实现了稳定且无性能衰退的10天（240小时）PM2.5预测，R²达到0.73。
AI.conclusion: 该框架克服了传统深度学习在长周期预测中的不稳定性，具备计算高效、不依赖外部仿真工具以及可扩展性强的优势，能够有效满足公共卫生早期预警系统的要求，特别适合在资源受限的城市环境中部署。
AI.translation: 可靠的PM2.5浓度长周期预测对公共卫生早期预警系统至关重要，然而现有的深度学习方法在超过48小时后难以维持预测稳定性，特别是在监测网络稀疏的城市中。本文提出了一种深度学习框架，将用于智能站点相似性选择的动态时间规整（DTW）与CNN-GRU架构相结合，以实现伊朗伊斯法罕（该城市具有复杂的污染动态和有限的监测覆盖范围）的延伸时效PM2.5预测。与依赖高计算消耗的Transformer模型或外部仿真工具的现有方法不同，我们的方法融合了三项关键创新：(i) 基于DTW的历史采样以识别对等站点间相似的污染模式；(ii) 融合气象特征的轻量化CNN-GRU架构；(iii) 针对稀疏网络优化的可扩展设计。基于8个监测站多年的逐小时数据进行的实验验证表明，与现有最新的深度学习方法相比，该模型表现出优越的性能，24小时预测的R²达到0.91。值得注意的是，这是首个展示出长达10天（240小时，R²=0.73）稳定PM2.5预测且性能未出现衰退的研究，解决了早期预警系统的关键需求。该框架的计算效率及其对外部工具的独立性，使其特别适合在资源受限的城市环境中部署。
AI.summary: 本文针对稀疏监测网络下PM2.5长周期预测稳定性不足的问题，提出了一种结合DTW与轻量级CNN-GRU的新型深度学习框架。该方法通过DTW识别站点间相似的污染模式，并融合气象特征进行时空建模，摆脱了对复杂Transformer模型或外部仿真工具的依赖。实验证明，该模型不仅在24小时预测中表现优异（R²=0.91），更首次实现了稳定且无性能衰退的10天（240小时）长效预警（R²=0.73），为资源受限城市的空气质量管理提供了高效可行的解决方案。
AI.keywords: PM2.5预测, 动态时间规整 (DTW), CNN-GRU, 稀疏监测网络, 长周期预测
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地利用动态时间规整（DTW）解决了稀疏监测网络下的站点相似性匹配问题，并结合轻量化CNN-GRU架构突破了传统深度学习在空气质量预测中难以维持48小时以上稳定性的瓶颈，首次实现了长达10天的稳定PM2.5预测。其无需依赖复杂Transformer和外部仿真工具的特性使得模型兼具高准确率与低计算成本，在资源受限城市的公共健康预警中具有突出的应用价值。

title: Mixed precision multigrid with smoothing based on incomplete Cholesky factorization
summary: Multigrid methods are popular iterative methods for solving large-scale sparse systems of linear equations. We present a mixed precision formulation of the multigrid V-cycle method with general assumptions on the finite precision errors coming from the application of coarsest-level solver and smoothing. Inspired by existing analysis, we derive a bound on the relative finite precision error of the V-cycle which gives insight into how the finite precision errors from the individual components of the method may affect the overall finite precision error. We use the result to study V-cycle methods with smoothing based on incomplete Cholesky factorization. The results imply that in certain settings, the precisions used for applying the incomplete Cholesky smoothing can be significantly lower than the precision used for computing the residual, restriction, prolongation, and correction on a given level. We perform numerical experiments using simulated floating point arithmetic with the MATLAB Advanpix toolbox as well as experiments on GPUs using the Ginkgo library. The experiments illustrate the theoretical findings and show that in the considered settings, the incomplete Cholesky smoothing can be applied in relatively low precisions, resulting in significant improvements in the execution time (up to 28% less), energy savings (up to 26% less) and required memory (up to 16% less) in comparison with the uniform double precision variant.

AI.title_translation: 基于不完全Cholesky分解平滑的混合精度多网格方法
AI.tldr: 提出了基于不完全Cholesky平滑的混合精度多网格V型循环方法，理论与GPU实验表明低精度平滑可使运行时间减少高达28%、能耗降低26%、内存需求减少16%。
AI.motivation: 探究多网格V型循环方法中各组件（如平滑器和最粗网格求解器）的有限精度误差对整体误差的影响，以期在保证算法收敛性和精度的同时，利用低精度算术降低大规模计算的计算时间、能耗和内存占用。
AI.method: 提出了多网格V型循环的混合精度公式，推导了相对有限精度误差的理论界限；针对基于不完全Cholesky分解的平滑方法进行了深入分析；利用MATLAB Advanpix工具箱模拟浮点算术，并在GPU上使用Ginkgo库进行了数值实验验证。
AI.result: 理论分析与实验均表明，平滑操作可在相对较低的精度下执行；与统一的双精度变体相比，混合精度方法使执行时间减少高达28%，能耗降低高达26%，内存需求减少高达16%。
AI.conclusion: 在多网格V型循环中，不完全Cholesky平滑步骤可以在较低精度下运行，而残差、限制、插值和修正等操作保留较高精度，该混合精度策略能够有效降低资源消耗并提升计算效率。
AI.translation: 多网格方法是求解大规模稀疏线性方程组的常用迭代方法。我们提出了多网格V型循环方法的混合精度公式，对最粗网格求解器和平滑应用所产生的有限精度误差作出了通用假设。受现有分析启发，我们推导了V型循环相对有限精度误差的界，这为方法中各个组件的有限精度误差如何影响整体有限精度误差提供了深入理解。我们使用该结果研究了基于不完全Cholesky分解平滑的V型循环方法。结果表明，在某些设定下，应用不完全Cholesky平滑所使用的精度可以明显低于在给定层级上计算残差、限制、插值和修正所使用的精度。我们使用MATLAB Advanpix工具箱的模拟浮点算术进行了数值实验，并在GPU上使用Ginkgo库进行了实验。实验验证了理论发现，并表明在所考虑的设定下，不完全Cholesky平滑可以在相对较低的精度下应用，与统一双精度变体相比，执行时间显著改善（减少高达28%），节省能源（减少高达26%），所需内存减少（减少高达16%）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种混合精度的多网格V型循环方法，重点研究了基于不完全Cholesky分解的平滑操作。通过推导相对有限精度误差的界限，论文证明了平滑步骤可以在比残差计算、限制、插值和修正等关键步骤更低的精度下运行。GPU及模拟浮点实验证实，该混合精度策略可在显著减少时间、能耗和内存占用的同时保持计算有效性。
AI.keywords: 多网格方法, 混合精度, 不完全Cholesky分解, V型循环, GPU加速
AI.comments:
创新性：本文将混合精度计算引入多网格V型循环，并首次针对基于不完全Cholesky分解的平滑器推导了误差界限，揭示了不同运算组件对精度敏感度的差异。
重要性：在高性能计算和GPU加速背景下，该方法在不损失精度的前提下显著降低了计算时间、能耗和内存消耗（如执行时间减少达28%），对大规模稀疏线性方程组的高效求解具有重要的实用价值。
局限性：理论分析和实验主要建立在特定的对称正定矩阵及不完全Cholesky平滑器假设上，在更复杂的非对称或病态问题上的推广性有待验证。

title: Spanning Tree Covers for Path-Separable Graphs: Trading Stretch for Size
summary:
Given a graph $G=(V,E)$, a collection $\mathcal{T}$ of spanning trees of $G$ is called a spanning tree cover of stretch $α$ if for every $u,v\in V$ there is a tree $T_{uv}\in\mathcal{T}$, such that \[d_{T_{uv}}(u,v)\leqα\cdot d_G(u,v)~.\]
  Spanning tree covers were introduced in the pioneering work of Gupta et al. [GKR04], that showed that $p$-path-separable graphs admit stretch-$3$ spanning tree covers with size $O(p\log n)$. Many subsequent papers focused on a relaxed notion of non-spanning tree covers, in which the trees are required to be dominating, but may use edges that do not belong to the graph. In particular, Bartal et al. [BFN22] devised a construction of non-spanning tree covers with stretch $1+ε$ and size $O(p\cdot\frac{\log^2n}{ε^2})$. Recently, for $K_r$-minor-free graphs, Chang et al. [CCL+23,CCL+24] devised a non-spanning tree cover with stretch $1+ε$ and size $2^{\frac{1}εr^{O(r)}}$, and an exact spanning tree cover with size $r^{O(diam(G))}$. However, the problem of devising spanning tree covers with stretch smaller than $3$ and small size for general $p$-path-separable graphs remained open.
  We show that $p$-path-separable graphs admit spanning tree covers with stretch $1+ε$ and size $O(p\cdot\frac{\log^2n}ε)$. Moreover, we demonstrate that one can trade stretch for size, and devise spanning tree covers with stretch $O(k\log\log p)$ and size $O(kp^{\frac{1}{k}}\cdot\log^{2}n)$ for strongly $p$-path-separable graphs. We also provide a tradeoff for weakly path-separable graphs. For $K_r$-minor-free graphs, we devise spanning tree covers with stretch $O(k\log\log r)$ and size $O(kr^{2+\frac{1}{k}}\cdot\log^{2}n)$. For such graphs, it is only known that $p=r^{4602}$. Thus, for $r=Ω(\log n)$ and $k\geq2$, this size is much smaller than that of our tree cover of stretch $1+ε$.

AI.title_translation: 路径可分图的生成树覆盖：权衡伸展度与尺寸
AI.tldr: 本文首次为路径可分图构造了伸展度小于3（甚至 $1+\epsilon$）的生成树覆盖，并提出了伸展度与覆盖尺寸之间的权衡机制。
AI.motivation: 解决一般 $p$-路径可分图（$p$-path-separable graphs）在伸展度小于 3 且集合尺寸较小的条件下的生成树覆盖构造难题（此前研究仅能做到伸展度为 3 或需要使用非生成树覆盖）。
AI.method: 针对强/弱 $p$-路径可分图以及无 $K_r$-minor 图，设计了能够权衡伸展度（Stretch）和覆盖集尺寸（Size）的生成树覆盖构造算法与结构。
AI.result:
1. 证明了 $p$-路径可分图存在伸展度为 $1+\epsilon$、尺寸为 $O(p \cdot \frac{\log^2 n}{\epsilon})$ 的生成树覆盖。
2. 对强 $p$-路径可分图，提出了伸展度为 $O(k \log \log p)$、尺寸为 $O(k p^{1/k} \cdot \log^2 n)$ 的权衡构造。
3. 给出了弱路径可分图的权衡方案。
4. 对无 $K_r$-minor 图，构建了伸展度为 $O(k \log \log r)$、尺寸为 $O(k r^{2+1/k} \cdot \log^2 n)$ 的生成树覆盖，在 $r=\Omega(\log n)$ 且 $k \ge 2$ 时尺寸显著小于 $1+\epsilon$ 伸展度的覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了路径可分图在小伸展度生成树覆盖上的空白，成功将伸展度降低至 $1+\epsilon$，并建立了伸展度与覆盖尺寸之间的权衡关系，极大优化了特定图类下的覆盖尺寸。
AI.translation:
给定图 $G=(V,E)$，$G$ 的生成树集合 $\mathcal{T}$ 被称为伸展度为 $\alpha$ 的生成树覆盖，如果对于每对顶点 $u,v \in V$，都存在一棵树 $T_{uv} \in \mathcal{T}$ 使得 $d_{T_{uv}}(u,v) \le \alpha \cdot d_G(u,v)$。生成树覆盖最早由 Gupta 等人 [GKR04] 提出，他们表明 $p$-路径可分图存在伸展度为 $3$、尺寸为 $O(p \log n)$ 的生成树覆盖。此后许多研究关注于松弛的非生成树覆盖概念，其中树被要求是支配树，但可以使用不属于原图的边。特别地，Bartal 等人 [BFN22] 设计了一种伸展度为 $1+\epsilon$、尺寸为 $O(p \cdot \frac{\log^2 n}{\epsilon^2})$ 的非生成树覆盖。最近，对于无 $K_r$-minor 图，Chang 等人 [CCL+23, CCL+24] 设计了伸展度为 $1+\epsilon$、尺寸为 $2^{\frac{1}{\epsilon} r^{O(r)}}$ 的非生成树覆盖，以及尺寸为 $r^{O(diam(G))}$ 的精确生成树覆盖。然而，对于一般 $p$-路径可分图，构造伸展度小于 $3$ 且尺寸较小的生成树覆盖问题仍未解决。

我们证明了 $p$-路径可分图存在伸展度为 $1+\epsilon$、尺寸为 $O(p \cdot \frac{\log^2 n}{\epsilon})$ 的生成树覆盖。此外，我们展示了可以在伸展度和尺寸之间进行权衡，并针对强 $p$-路径可分图设计了伸展度为 $O(k \log \log p)$、尺寸为 $O(k p^{\frac{1}{k}} \cdot \log^2 n)$ 的生成树覆盖。我们还为弱路径可分图提供了权衡方案。对于无 $K_r$-minor 图，我们设计了伸展度为 $O(k \log \log r)$、尺寸为 $O(k r^{2+\frac{1}{k}} \cdot \log^2 n)$ 的生成树覆盖。对于此类图，目前已知 $p=r^{4602}$。因此，当 $r=\Omega(\log n)$ 且 $k \ge 2$ 时，该尺寸远小于我们伸展度为 $1+\epsilon$ 的树覆盖尺寸。
AI.summary: 本文研究了路径可分图与无 $K_r$-minor 图的生成树覆盖问题。论文突破了以往生成树覆盖伸展度难以小于 3 的瓶颈，首次构造了伸展度为 $1+\epsilon$ 的生成树覆盖，并提出了伸展度与覆盖尺寸之间的权衡机制（Tradeoff），显著降低了特定参数条件下的覆盖尺寸。
AI.keywords: Spanning Tree Cover, Path-Separable Graphs, Stretch-Size Tradeoff, Minor-Free Graphs
AI.comments: 本文在图论与距离拟合/树覆盖领域取得了突破性进展。此前关于路径可分图的生成树覆盖，伸展度一直停留在3，或者需要借助非生成树（使用非原图边）。本文不仅将生成树覆盖的伸展度首次降低至 $1+\epsilon$，而且创造性地建立了伸展度与覆盖尺寸之间的权衡关系（Tradeoff），为网络路由和图距离近似算法等领域提供了极具价值的理论工具。

title: Economic Linear Quadratic MPC With Non-Unique Optimal Solutions
summary: Asymptotic stability in economic receding horizon control can be obtained under a strict dissipativity assumption, related to positive-definiteness of a so-called rotated cost, and through the use of suitable terminal cost and constraints. In the linear-quadratic case a common assumption is that the rotated cost is positive definite. The positive semi-definite case has received surprisingly little attention, and the connection to the standard dissipativity assumption has not been investigated. In this paper, we fill this gap by connecting existing results in economic model predictive control with the stability results for the semi-definite case, the properties of the constrained generalized discrete algebraic Riccati equation, and of two optimal control problems. Moreover, we extend recent results relating exponential stability to the choice of terminal cost in the absence of terminal constraints.

AI.title_translation: 经济线性二次MPC与非唯一最优解
AI.tldr: 本文填补了经济模型预测控制中正半定旋转成本案例的稳定性分析空白，通过连接现有结果、Riccati方程性质和最优控制问题，并扩展了无终端约束下指数稳定性与终端成本选择关系的研究。
AI.motivation: 在经济线性二次模型预测控制中，旋转成本正定性是一个常见假设，但正半定情况受到的关注很少，且其与标准耗散性假设的联系尚未被研究，这是一个研究空白。
AI.method: 本文通过以下方式填补了研究空白：将经济模型预测控制的现有结果与半定情况的稳定性结果、约束广义离散代数Riccati方程的性质以及两个最优控制问题联系起来。此外，还扩展了在没有终端约束的情况下，指数稳定性与终端成本选择相关的最新研究成果。
AI.result: 本文成功连接了经济模型预测控制的现有结果与半定情况的稳定性结果，揭示了约束广义离散代数Riccati方程的性质，分析了两个最优控制问题的特性，并扩展了在没有终端约束的情况下指数稳定性与终端成本选择相关的最新研究成果。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过连接现有理论、分析关键方程和扩展指数稳定性结果，填补了经济模型预测控制中正半定旋转成本情况下的稳定性分析空白，为该领域提供了新的见解。
AI.translation: 在经济回顾地平线控制中，可以通过严格耗散性假设（与所谓的旋转成本的正定性相关）以及使用合适的终端成本和约束来获得渐近稳定性。在线性二次情况下，一个常见的假设是旋转成本是正定的。然而，正半定情况受到的关注却出人意料地少，并且其与标准耗散性假设的联系尚未被研究。在本文中，我们通过将经济模型预测控制中的现有结果与半定情况的稳定性结果、约束广义离散代数Riccati方程的性质以及两个最优控制问题联系起来，填补了这一空白。此外，我们扩展了在没有终端约束的情况下，指数稳定性与终端成本选择相关的最新研究成果。
AI.summary: 本文关注经济线性二次模型预测控制中，旋转成本为正半定情况下的渐近稳定性问题，指出该领域研究不足且与标准耗散性假设的联系未被探究。为解决此问题，作者将经济模型预测控制的现有成果与半定情况的稳定性结果、约束广义离散代数Riccati方程的性质以及最优控制问题进行了联系，并进一步扩展了无终端约束时指数稳定性与终端成本选择关系的研究。
AI.keywords: 经济模型预测控制, 线性二次, 正半定, 渐近稳定性, Riccati方程
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于填补了经济模型预测控制中正半定旋转成本情况下的理论空白，这对于理解和设计更具鲁棒性的控制系统具有重要意义。通过连接多个理论领域，该研究为处理非严格耗散系统提供了新的视角和工具。

title: SurgSLOT: Segment Anything in Surgical Videos via Semantic Long-term Tracking
summary: Surgical scene understanding demands temporally consistent tracking of instruments and tissues. For clinical use, such tracking should generalize to new centers and procedure types, yet retraining for each of them is costly and not scalable. Interactive video object segmentation offers a way toward this generalization: the target is specified at inference by a first-frame visual prompt, so a model can generalize to unseen categories and new scenarios without retraining. However, training such a generalizable model demands spatio-temporal masklet annotations at a scale and procedural diversity that existing surgical benchmarks lack. We fill this gap with iSurg, the largest surgical segmentation benchmark to our knowledge, spanning six procedure types with over 170k frames, 410k object masks, and 2.4k masklets, including an in-house clinical dataset of four 30-minute videos. Yet tracking over such long videos remains challenging: the target needs to be re-identified among visually similar objects after long absences, while long-term memory has to judge whether each stored frame genuinely depicts the target, both demanding a stable object-level semantic identity. To this end, we propose SurgSLOT, a surgical segmentation generalist that segments any prompted target through two coupled modules built on this semantic identity: Temporal Semantic Learning learns it for re-identification, and Semantic-driven Long-term Memory reuses it to select reliable memory frames, suppressing identity drift over long procedures. On the SAM2 and SAM3 backbones, SurgSLOT reaches 81.0 and 82.8 Macro Average J&F under cross-dataset evaluation, surpassing their fine-tuned counterparts by 5.1 and 5.3 points and transferring zero-shot to an unseen procedure type and unseen object categories, with the SAM2 version running in real time at 68 FPS.

AI.title_translation: SurgSLOT：通过语义长期跟踪在手术视频中分割任何物体
AI.tldr: 本文提出了SurgSLOT，一个通用的手术视频分割模型，通过语义长期跟踪实现对任何提示目标的分割，并在大型新基准iSurg上表现出色，实现了跨数据集的泛化和实时性能。
AI.motivation: 手术场景理解需要对器械和组织进行时间上一致的跟踪，且需泛化到新的中心和手术类型，但为每种情况重新训练成本高昂且不可扩展。现有的手术基准缺乏大规模和程序多样性的时空masklet标注，导致交互式视频对象分割模型的泛化能力受限。
AI.method: 本文首先构建了iSurg，一个迄今为止最大的手术分割基准，涵盖六种手术类型，包含超过17万帧、41万个对象掩码和2.4千个masklet。在此基础上，提出了SurgSLOT，一个手术分割通用模型，通过两个耦合模块分割任何提示目标：时间语义学习（Temporal Semantic Learning）用于重识别，语义驱动的长期记忆（Semantic-driven Long-term Memory）用于选择可靠的记忆帧并抑制身份漂移。SurgSLOT基于SAM2和SAM3骨干网络。
AI.result: 在跨数据集评估中，SurgSLOT在SAM2和SAM3骨干网络上分别达到了81.0和82.8的宏观平均J&F分数，超越了它们的微调对应物5.1和5.3个百分点。该模型实现了对未见手术类型和未见对象类别的零样本迁移，其中SAM2版本以68 FPS的实时速度运行。
AI.conclusion: SurgSLOT通过其语义长期跟踪机制，有效解决了手术视频中交互式视频对象分割的泛化和长期跟踪挑战。该模型在新构建的大规模数据集iSurg上展示了卓越的性能和实时能力，有望推动手术场景理解的临床应用。
AI.translation: 手术场景理解需要对器械和组织进行时间上一致的跟踪。对于临床使用，这种跟踪应能泛化到新的中心和手术类型，但为每种情况重新训练成本高昂且不可扩展。交互式视频对象分割提供了一种实现这种泛化的方法：目标在推理时通过第一帧视觉提示进行指定，因此模型无需重新训练即可泛化到未见的类别和新场景。然而，训练这样一个可泛化模型需要大规模和程序多样性的时空masklet标注，而现有手术基准缺乏这些。我们通过iSurg填补了这一空白，据我们所知，这是最大的手术分割基准，涵盖六种手术类型，超过17万帧、41万个对象掩码和2.4千个masklet，包括一个内部临床数据集，包含四段30分钟的视频。然而，在如此长的视频中进行跟踪仍然具有挑战性：目标需要在长时间缺失后在视觉相似的对象中重新识别，同时长期记忆必须判断每个存储帧是否真实地描绘了目标，这两者都需要稳定的对象级语义身份。为此，我们提出了SurgSLOT，一个手术分割通用模型，通过基于这种语义身份构建的两个耦合模块分割任何提示目标：时间语义学习（Temporal Semantic Learning）学习用于重识别的语义身份，语义驱动的长期记忆（Semantic-driven Long-term Memory）重用它来选择可靠的记忆帧，抑制长时间手术中的身份漂移。在SAM2和SAM3骨干网络上，SurgSLOT在跨数据集评估中达到了81.0和82.8的宏观平均J&F，超越了它们的微调对应物5.1和5.3个百分点，并实现了对未见手术类型和未见对象类别的零样本迁移，其中SAM2版本以68 FPS的实时速度运行。
AI.summary: 本文针对手术视频中器械和组织跟踪的泛化性挑战，提出了SurgSLOT模型。首先，作者构建了迄今最大的手术分割基准iSurg，以弥补现有数据集的不足。随后，SurgSLOT通过耦合的时间语义学习和语义驱动的长期记忆模块，利用稳定的对象级语义身份，实现了对任何提示目标的精确分割和长期跟踪。实验结果表明，SurgSLOT在跨数据集评估中显著优于微调的基线模型，并展现了零样本泛化能力和实时性能。
AI.keywords: 手术视频分割, 语义长期跟踪, 交互式视频对象分割, iSurg, SurgSLOT
AI.comments: SurgSLOT的创新点在于其通过构建大型手术分割基准iSurg，并设计了基于语义身份的长期跟踪机制，有效解决了手术视频中交互式分割的泛化性和长期跟踪难题。特别是其提出的时间语义学习和语义驱动的长期记忆模块，对于在复杂手术环境中保持对象身份稳定性至关重要。该方法在零样本迁移和实时性能方面的表现，预示着其在临床应用中的巨大潜力。

title: SAM-MI: A Mask-Injected Framework for Enhancing Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with SAM
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) aims to segment and recognize objects universally. Trained on extensive high-quality segmentation data, the segment anything model (SAM) has demonstrated remarkable universal segmentation capabilities, offering valuable support for OVSS. Although previous methods have made progress in leveraging SAM for OVSS, there are still some challenges: (1) SAM's tendency to over-segment and (2) hard combinations between fixed masks and labels. This paper introduces a novel mask-injected framework, SAM-MI, which effectively integrates SAM with OVSS models to address these challenges. Initially, SAM-MI employs a Text-guided Sparse Point Prompter to sample sparse prompts for SAM instead of previous dense grid-like prompts, thus significantly accelerating the mask generation process. The framework then introduces Shallow Mask Aggregation (SMAgg) to merge partial masks to mitigate the SAM's over-segmentation issue. Finally, Decoupled Mask Injection (DMI) incorporates SAM-generated masks for guidance at low-frequency and high-frequency separately, rather than directly combining them with labels. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks validate the superiority of SAM-MI. Notably, the proposed method achieves a 16.7% relative improvement in mIoU over Grounded-SAM on the MESS benchmark, along with a 1.6$\times$ speedup. We hope SAM-MI can serve as an alternative methodology to effectively equip the OVSS model with SAM.

AI.title_translation: SAM-MI：一种用于增强开放词汇语义分割的掩码注入框架，结合SAM
AI.tldr: SAM-MI框架通过稀疏提示、浅层掩码聚合和解耦掩码注入，解决了SAM在开放词汇语义分割中的过分割和掩码-标签组合难题，显著提升了性能和速度。
AI.motivation: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）旨在普遍分割和识别物体。尽管Segment Anything Model (SAM) 具有卓越的通用分割能力，但在将其应用于OVSS时仍面临挑战：(1) SAM倾向于过度分割；(2) 固定掩码与标签之间的组合困难。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个新颖的掩码注入框架SAM-MI。它首先采用文本引导的稀疏点提示器（Text-guided Sparse Point Prompter）为SAM采样稀疏提示，以加速掩码生成。接着，引入浅层掩码聚合（Shallow Mask Aggregation, SMAgg）来合并部分掩码，以减轻SAM的过度分割问题。最后，通过解耦掩码注入（Decoupled Mask Injection, DMI）在低频和高频处分别注入SAM生成的掩码进行指导，而不是直接将它们与标签结合。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的广泛实验验证了SAM-MI的优越性。具体而言，在MESS基准测试上，所提出的方法在mIoU方面比Grounded-SAM实现了16.7%的相对改进，同时速度提升了1.6倍。
AI.conclusion: SAM-MI框架能够有效地为开放词汇语义分割模型装备SAM，解决了现有挑战，并提供了一种替代方法。
AI.translation: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）旨在普遍地分割和识别物体。在大量高质量分割数据上训练的Segment Anything Model (SAM) 展示了卓越的通用分割能力，为OVSS提供了宝贵支持。尽管先前的方法在利用SAM进行OVSS方面取得了进展，但仍存在一些挑战：（1）SAM倾向于过度分割，以及（2）固定掩码与标签之间的困难组合。本文引入了一种新颖的掩码注入框架SAM-MI，它有效地将SAM与OVSS模型集成，以解决这些挑战。最初，SAM-MI采用文本引导的稀疏点提示器来为SAM采样稀疏提示，而不是先前的密集网格状提示，从而显著加速了掩码生成过程。该框架随后引入了浅层掩码聚合（SMAgg）来合并部分掩码，以减轻SAM的过度分割问题。最后，解耦掩码注入（DMI）分别在低频和高频处引入SAM生成的掩码进行指导，而不是直接将它们与标签结合。在多个基准测试上进行的广泛实验验证了SAM-MI的优越性。值得注意的是，所提出的方法在MESS基准测试上比Grounded-SAM在mIoU方面实现了16.7%的相对改进，同时速度提高了1.6倍。我们希望SAM-MI能够作为一种替代方法，有效地为OVSS模型装备SAM。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SAM-MI，一个新颖的掩码注入框架，旨在增强开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）并解决SAM在OVSS中存在的过分割和掩码-标签组合难题。SAM-MI通过引入文本引导的稀疏点提示器加速掩码生成，使用浅层掩码聚合（SMAgg）缓解过分割，并通过解耦掩码注入（DMI）在不同频率下指导掩码，而不是直接与标签结合。实验证明，SAM-MI在mIoU和速度上均优于现有方法，例如在MESS基准上mIoU相对提升16.7%，速度提升1.6倍。
AI.keywords: 开放词汇语义分割, SAM, 掩码注入, 过分割, 稀疏提示
AI.comments: SAM-MI通过引入稀疏提示、浅层掩码聚合和解耦掩码注入等创新机制，有效解决了SAM在开放词汇语义分割中的核心挑战，即过分割和掩码与标签的硬组合问题。其显著的性能提升和速度优化表明了该框架在实际应用中的巨大潜力，为未来结合通用分割模型和OVSS提供了有价值的参考范式。

title: Dataset Poisoning Attacks on Behavioral Cloning Policies
summary: Behavior Cloning (BC) is a popular framework for training sequential decision policies from expert demonstrations via supervised learning. As these policies are increasingly being deployed in the real world, their robustness and potential vulnerabilities are an important concern. In this work, we perform the first analysis of the efficacy of clean-label backdoor attacks on BC policies. Our backdoor attacks poison a dataset of demonstrations by injecting a visual trigger to create a spurious correlation that can be exploited at test time. We evaluate how policy vulnerability scales with the fraction of poisoned data, the strength of the trigger, and the trigger type. We also introduce a novel entropy-based test-time trigger attack that substantially degrades policy performance by identifying critical states where test-time triggering of the backdoor is expected to be most effective at degrading performance. We empirically demonstrate that BC policies trained on even minimally poisoned datasets exhibit deceptively high, near-baseline task performance despite being highly vulnerable to backdoor trigger attacks during deployment. Our results underscore the urgent need for more research into the robustness of BC policies, particularly as large-scale datasets are increasingly used to train policies for real-world cyber-physical systems. Videos and code are available at https://sites.google.com/view/dataset-poisoning-in-bc.

AI.title_translation: 数据集投毒攻击对行为克隆策略的影响
AI.tldr: 行为克隆（BC）策略容易受到数据集投毒攻击，即使在少量投毒数据下，策略在部署时仍表现出高任务性能，但对后门触发攻击高度脆弱，这凸显了对BC策略鲁棒性研究的迫切需求。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆（BC）策略越来越多地部署在现实世界中，因此其鲁棒性和潜在漏洞是一个重要的关注点。
AI.method: 本文对BC策略上的干净标签后门攻击的有效性进行了首次分析。攻击通过注入视觉触发器来毒害演示数据集，以创建可在测试时利用的虚假相关性。研究评估了策略漏洞如何随投毒数据比例、触发器强度和触发器类型而变化。还引入了一种新颖的基于熵的测试时触发攻击，通过识别预期最能降低性能的关键状态来显著降低策略性能。
AI.result: 经验证明，即使在最少量投毒的数据集上训练的BC策略，尽管对部署期间的后门触发攻击高度脆弱，但仍表现出欺骗性的高、接近基线的任务性能。结果强调了对BC策略鲁棒性进行更多研究的迫切需求，特别是随着大规模数据集越来越多地用于训练现实世界网络物理系统的策略。
AI.conclusion: BC策略在数据集投毒攻击下表现出显著的漏洞，即使投毒数据量很小。尽管在表面上任务性能良好，但这些策略在部署时极易受到后门触发攻击的影响，因此迫切需要加强对BC策略鲁棒性的研究。
AI.translation: 行为克隆（BC）是一种流行的框架，通过监督学习从专家演示中训练顺序决策策略。随着这些策略越来越多地部署在现实世界中，它们的鲁棒性和潜在漏洞是一个重要的关注点。在这项工作中，我们首次分析了干净标签后门攻击对BC策略的有效性。我们的后门攻击通过注入视觉触发器来毒害演示数据集，以创建可在测试时利用的虚假相关性。我们评估了策略漏洞如何随投毒数据比例、触发器强度和触发器类型而变化。我们还引入了一种新颖的基于熵的测试时触发攻击，通过识别预期最能有效降低性能的关键状态来显著降低策略性能。我们经验性地证明，即使在最少量投毒的数据集上训练的BC策略，尽管在部署期间对后门触发攻击高度脆弱，但仍表现出欺骗性的高、接近基线的任务性能。我们的结果强调了对BC策略鲁棒性进行更多研究的迫切需求，特别是随着大规模数据集越来越多地用于训练现实世界网络物理系统的策略。视频和代码可在https://sites.google.com/view/dataset-poisoning-in-bc获取。
AI.summary: 本研究首次探讨了数据集投毒攻击对行为克隆（BC）策略的影响。通过注入视觉触发器进行干净标签后门攻击，研究发现BC策略即使在少量投毒数据下也能保持高任务性能，但在部署时对后门触发攻击表现出高度脆弱性。论文还提出了一种基于熵的测试时触发攻击，以更有效地降低策略性能。结果强调了对BC策略鲁棒性进行深入研究的紧迫性，尤其是在处理大规模数据集和实际应用时。
AI.keywords: 行为克隆, 数据集投毒, 后门攻击, 策略鲁棒性, 机器学习安全
AI.comments: 这项工作首次揭示了行为克隆策略在数据集投毒攻击下的潜在脆弱性，即使是干净标签的攻击也能成功。其创新之处在于引入了基于熵的测试时触发攻击，能更有效地识别和利用策略的漏洞。重要性在于其结果对依赖行为克隆的现实世界系统（如自动驾驶或机器人）的安全性和鲁棒性提出了严峻挑战，强调了在部署这些系统之前进行严格安全评估的必要性。

title: MSG-Loc: Multi-Label Likelihood-based Semantic Graph Matching for Object-Level Global Localization
comments: Accepted in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (2025)
summary: Robots are often required to localize in environments with unknown object classes and semantic ambiguity. However, when performing global localization using semantic objects, high semantic ambiguity intensifies object misclassification and increases the likelihood of incorrect associations, which in turn can cause significant errors in the estimated pose. Thus, in this letter, we propose a multi-label likelihood-based semantic graph matching framework for object-level global localization. The key idea is to exploit multi-label graph representations, rather than single-label alternatives, to capture and leverage the inherent semantic context of object observations. Based on these representations, our approach enhances semantic correspondence across graphs by combining the likelihood of each node with the maximum likelihood of its neighbors via context-aware likelihood propagation. For rigorous validation, data association and pose estimation performance are evaluated under both closed-set and open-set detection configurations. In addition, we demonstrate the scalability of our approach to large-vocabulary object categories in both real-world indoor scenes and synthetic environments. Project Page: https://sparolab.github.io/research/msg-loc/.
comment: Accepted in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (2025)

AI.title_translation: MSG-Loc：基于多标签似然的语义图匹配用于物体级全局定位
AI.tldr: MSG-Loc提出了一种基于多标签似然的语义图匹配框架，用于物体级全局定位，以解决高语义模糊性导致的物体误分类和不正确关联问题，通过利用多标签图表示和上下文感知似然传播来提高语义对应性。
AI.motivation: 机器人在未知物体类别和语义模糊的环境中进行定位时，高语义模糊性会导致物体误分类和不正确关联，进而引起位姿估计的显著误差。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于多标签似然的语义图匹配框架（MSG-Loc），用于物体级全局定位。其核心思想是利用多标签图表示来捕捉和利用物体观测的固有语义上下文，而不是使用单标签替代方案。该方法通过将每个节点的似然与其邻居的最大似然结合，通过上下文感知似然传播来增强图之间的语义对应。
AI.result: 在封闭集和开放集检测配置下评估了数据关联和位姿估计性能。该方法在真实世界室内场景和合成环境中，对大词汇量物体类别表现出可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种有效的多标签似然语义图匹配框架MSG-Loc，通过利用多标签图表示和上下文感知似然传播，解决了物体级全局定位中语义模糊性带来的挑战，并在各种环境下展示了其性能和可扩展性。
AI.translation: 机器人通常需要在具有未知物体类别和语义模糊性的环境中进行定位。然而，在使用语义物体进行全局定位时，高语义模糊性会加剧物体的错误分类并增加不正确关联的可能性，这反过来会导致估计位姿的显著误差。因此，本文提出了一种基于多标签似然的语义图匹配框架，用于物体级全局定位。其核心思想是利用多标签图表示，而不是单标签替代方案，来捕获和利用物体观测的固有语义上下文。基于这些表示，我们的方法通过将每个节点的似然与其邻居的最大似然相结合，通过上下文感知似然传播来增强图之间的语义对应。为了进行严格验证，在封闭集和开放集检测配置下评估了数据关联和位姿估计性能。此外，我们展示了我们的方法在真实世界室内场景和合成环境中对大词汇量物体类别的可扩展性。项目页面：https://sparolab.github.io/research/msg-loc/。
AI.summary: MSG-Loc提出了一种基于多标签似然的语义图匹配框架，用于解决机器人全局定位中因语义模糊性导致的物体误分类和不正确关联问题。该方法利用多标签图表示来捕获语义上下文，并通过上下文感知似然传播增强图之间的语义对应。在封闭集和开放集检测配置下，该方法在数据关联和位姿估计方面表现良好，并对大词汇量物体类别具有可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 全局定位, 语义图匹配, 多标签似然, 语义模糊性, 机器人定位
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了基于多标签似然的语义图匹配框架，有效解决了在复杂环境中进行物体级全局定位时，高语义模糊性导致的挑战。通过利用多标签图表示和上下文感知似然传播，提高了语义对应和定位精度，对机器人导航和感知领域具有重要意义。

title: RefBench-PRO: Perceptual and Reasoning Oriented Benchmark for Referring Expression Comprehension
summary: Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) is a vision-language task that localizes a specific image region based on a textual description. Existing REC benchmarks primarily evaluate perceptual capabilities and lack interpretable scoring mechanisms, which cannot reveal the grounding capability of Multi-modal Large Language Model (MLLM) across different cognitive abilities. To address this limitation, we introduce RefBench-PRO, a comprehensive REC benchmark, which decomposes referring expressions into two core dimensions, i.e., perception and reasoning, and further subdivides them into six progressively challenging tasks, such as attribute, position, interaction, commonsense, relation and reject. We also develop a fully automated data-generation pipeline that produces diverse referring expressions across these six sub-dimensions. Furthermore, We propose Ref-R1, an RL-based learning scheme, which incorporates Dynamic IoU-based GRPO to improve localization accuracy under increasingly complex reasoning conditions, establishing a stronger baseline for REC. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our RefBench-PRO enables interpretable evaluation of MLLM on referring expression comprehension, presenting greater challenges in both perception and reasoning.

AI.title_translation: RefBench-PRO：面向感知和推理的指代表达理解基准
AI.tldr: 现有指代表达理解（REC）基准在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的认知能力方面存在局限。本文提出了RefBench-PRO，一个将REC任务分解为感知和推理两个维度并包含六个子任务的综合基准，并开发了自动化数据生成管道。此外，还提出了基于RL的Ref-R1学习方案以提高定位精度。实验证明RefBench-PRO能对MLLM进行可解释评估，并带来更大的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有指代表达理解（REC）基准主要评估感知能力，缺乏可解释的评分机制，无法揭示多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在不同认知能力下的基础能力。
AI.method: 1. 引入RefBench-PRO，一个综合的REC基准，将指代表达分解为感知和推理两个核心维度，并进一步细分为属性、位置、交互、常识、关系和拒绝六个渐进挑战性任务。 2. 开发了全自动化数据生成管道，以在六个子维度上生成多样化的指代表达。 3. 提出了Ref-R1，一种基于强化学习（RL）的学习方案，该方案结合了基于动态IoU的GRPO，以在日益复杂的推理条件下提高定位精度，为REC建立了更强的基线。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，RefBench-PRO能够对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在指代表达理解方面进行可解释的评估，并在感知和推理方面提出了更大的挑战。
AI.conclusion: RefBench-PRO提供了一个更全面、可解释的REC评估框架，能够更好地衡量MLLM的认知能力，并为未来的研究设定了更具挑战性的基线。
AI.translation: 指代表达理解（REC）是一项视觉-语言任务，它根据文本描述定位特定的图像区域。现有的REC基准主要评估感知能力，并且缺乏可解释的评分机制，这无法揭示多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在不同认知能力下的基础能力。为了解决这一局限性，我们引入了RefBench-PRO，一个综合的REC基准，它将指代表达分解为感知和推理两个核心维度，并进一步细分为六个渐进挑战性任务，例如属性、位置、交互、常识、关系和拒绝。我们还开发了一个全自动化数据生成管道，可以在这六个子维度上生成多样化的指代表达。此外，我们提出了Ref-R1，一种基于强化学习（RL）的学习方案，它结合了基于动态IoU的GRPO，以在日益复杂的推理条件下提高定位精度，为REC建立了更强的基线。广泛的实验表明，我们的RefBench-PRO能够对多模态大语言模型在指代表达理解方面进行可解释的评估，并在感知和推理方面提出了更大的挑战。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有指代表达理解（REC）基准在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）认知能力方面的局限性，提出了RefBench-PRO。RefBench-PRO是一个综合性REC基准，将指代表达任务分解为感知和推理两个核心维度，并细分为六个渐进式挑战性子任务。同时，开发了自动化数据生成管道以丰富数据多样性。此外，本文还提出了一种基于强化学习的Ref-R1学习方案，通过结合动态IoU的GRPO来提高复杂推理条件下的定位精度，为REC任务提供了更强的基线。实验证明RefBench-PRO能够对MLLM进行可解释评估，并在感知和推理方面带来了更大的挑战。
AI.keywords: 指代表达理解, 多模态大语言模型, 基准, 感知, 推理
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个更全面、更具挑战性和可解释性的REC基准RefBench-PRO，它将任务细分为感知和推理的六个子维度，并引入了自动化数据生成管道。同时，提出的Ref-R1学习方案也为提高REC任务的定位精度提供了新的方法。这对于深入理解和评估MLLM在视觉-语言理解方面的真实能力具有重要意义。

title: Design in Tiles: Automating GEMM Deployment on Tile-Based Many-PE Accelerators
summary: Tile-based many-Processing Element (PE) accelerators can achieve competitive performance on General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM), but they are extremely hard to program, as their optimal software mapping is deeply coupled with hardware design which is unwieldy to manual deployment. We propose "Design in Tiles (DiT)", an automated framework connecting a deployment toolchain with a configurable executable model for these accelerators. For evaluation, we apply our framework to GEMM targeting a large acceleration configuration (e.g., 32x32 tiles, 1979 TFLOPS@FP8, 4 TB/s Bandwidth) comparable to an NVIDIA GH200. We achieve higher PE utilization than GH200 with its expert-tuned GEMM libraries, achieving 1.2-2.0x speedup across diverse matrix shapes.

AI.title_translation: 瓦片设计：自动化GEMM在基于瓦片的多PE加速器上的部署
AI.tldr: DiT是一个自动化框架，用于在基于瓦片的多PE加速器上部署GEMM，实现了比NVIDIA GH200更高的PE利用率和1.2-2.0倍的速度提升。
AI.motivation: 基于瓦片的多处理单元（PE）加速器在通用矩阵乘法（GEMM）上可以实现有竞争力的性能，但其编程极其困难，因为其最优软件映射与硬件设计深度耦合，手动部署难以处理。
AI.method: 我们提出了“瓦片设计（DiT）”，这是一个自动化框架，将部署工具链与这些加速器的可配置可执行模型连接起来。
AI.result: 我们将DiT框架应用于针对大型加速配置（例如32x32瓦片，1979 TFLOPS@FP8，4 TB/s带宽）的GEMM，该配置可与NVIDIA GH200相媲美。DiT实现了比GH200及其专家调优的GEMM库更高的PE利用率，并在不同矩阵形状上实现了1.2-2.0倍的速度提升。
AI.conclusion: DiT框架成功地自动化了GEMM在基于瓦片的多PE加速器上的部署，显著提高了性能和PE利用率，超越了现有专家调优的解决方案。

AI.keywords: GEMM, 瓦片加速器, 自动化部署, PE利用率, DiT
AI.comments: 该论文通过提出DiT框架，解决了基于瓦片的多PE加速器编程复杂性的关键问题，为自动化高性能计算部署提供了创新方法。其在性能上超越专家调优的GH200库，显示了其重要性和潜力。

title: Physics of Language Models: Part 4.1, Architecture Design and the Magic of Canon Layers
comments: V1.1 appeared in NeurIPS 2025 main conference; V2 adds GDN experiments, tightens others for a stronger, fairer comparison, and reorganizes sections; V3 adds Result 2.1 and Section 5.2 on how Canon layers improve hierarchical feature learning, from our Jan 2026 talk
summary:
Understanding architectural differences in language models is challenging, especially at academic-scale pretraining (e.g., 1.3B parameters, 100B tokens), where results are often dominated by noise and randomness. To overcome this, we introduce controlled synthetic pretraining tasks that isolate and evaluate core model capabilities. Within this framework, we discover CANON LAYERS: lightweight architectural components -- named after the musical term "canon" -- that promote horizontal information flow across neighboring tokens. Canon layers compute weighted sums of nearby token representations and integrate seamlessly into Transformers, linear attention, state-space models, or any sequence architecture.
  We present 12 key results. This includes how Canon layers enhance reasoning depth (e.g., by $2\times$), reasoning breadth, knowledge manipulation, etc. They lift weak architectures like NoPE to match RoPE, and linear attention to rival SOTA linear models like Mamba2/GDN -- validated both through synthetic tasks and real-world academic-scale pretraining. This synthetic playground offers an economical, principled path to isolate core model capabilities often obscured at academic scales. Equipped with infinite high-quality data, it may even PREDICT how future architectures will behave as training pipelines improve -- e.g., through better data curation or RL-based post-training -- unlocking deeper reasoning and hierarchical inference.

title: Robustness Certificates for Neural Networks Against Data Poisoning and Evasion Attacks
summary: The increasing use of machine learning in safety-critical domains amplifies the risk of adversarial threats, especially data poisoning attacks that corrupt training data to degrade performance or induce unsafe behavior. Most existing defenses lack formal guarantees or rely on restrictive assumptions about the model class, attack type, extent of poisoning, or point-wise certification, limiting their practical reliability. This paper introduces a principled formal robustness certification framework that models gradient-based training as a discrete-time dynamical system (dt-DS) and formulates poisoning robustness as a formal safety verification problem. By adapting the concept of barrier certificates (BCs) from control theory, we introduce sufficient conditions to certify a robust radius ensuring that the terminal model remains safe under worst-case ${\ell}_p$-norm-based poisoning. To make this practical, we parameterize BCs as neural networks trained on finite sets of poisoned trajectories. We further derive probably approximately correct (PAC) bounds by solving a scenario convex program (SCP), which yields a confidence lower bound on the certified robustness radius generalizing beyond the training set. Importantly, our framework also extends to certification against test-time attacks, making it the first unified framework to provide formal guarantees in both training and test-time attack settings. Experiments on MNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 show that our approach certifies non-trivial perturbation budgets while being model-agnostic and requiring no prior knowledge of the attack or contamination level.

title: End-to-End 3-D Spatiotemporal Perception with Multimodal Fusion and V2X Collaboration
summary: Multiview cooperative perception and multimodal fusion are essential for reliable 3-D spatiotemporal understanding in autonomous driving, especially in cases with occlusions, limited viewpoints, and communication delays in vehicle-to-everything (V2X) scenarios. In this paper, Cross-modal End-to-End Tracking for V2X (XET-V2X), a multimodal fused end-to-end tracking framework for V2X collaboration that unifies multiview multimodal sensing within a shared spatiotemporal representation, is proposed. To efficiently align heterogeneous viewpoints and modalities, XET-V2X introduces a dual-layer spatial cross-attention module based on multiscale deformable attention. Multiview image features are aggregated to enhance semantic consistency, followed by point cloud fusion guided by the updated spatial queries, enabling effective cross-modal interaction while reducing computational overhead. Experiments based on the real-world V2X Sequential Perception Dataset (V2X-Seq-SPD) dataset and two simulated V2X-Sim-derived subsets, namely the vehicle-to-vehicle (V2X-Sim-V2V) and vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2X-Sim-V2I) subsets, demonstrate consistent improvements in detection and tracking performance under varying communication delays, with XET-V2X achieving up to 15-20% relative gains in mean average precision (mAP) and average multi-object tracking accuracy (AMOTA) over single-view or single-modal baselines, while also outperforming representative tracking-by-detection cooperative perception methods.

title: Deep Delta Learning
summary: Transformer residual streams evolve through additive updates. Although a sufficiently expressive residual block can represent content replacement, standard architectures do not parameterize reading, comparison, and replacement as an explicit residual operation. We introduce Deep Delta Learning (DDL), a structured residual update that preserves the identity path while enabling target-seeking edits to the residual state. Each layer reads the current state along a learned direction, compares the resulting readout with a learned target, and writes back a gated rank-1 correction along the same direction. Closing the gate recovers the identity map, while fully opening it exactly overwrites the selected residual readout. We instantiate DDL with both scalar and expanded residual states. The expanded formulation provides multiple persistent value channels while keeping attention and MLP computation at the original model width, thereby separating residual-state capacity from backbone compute width. Controlled LLM pretraining experiments show that DDL improves language-modeling quality and average one-shot downstream performance over additive residual baselines in the reported runs, while introducing explicit memory and throughput tradeoffs. These results suggest that depth-wise delta-rule updates provide a useful inductive bias for managing Transformer residual streams.

title: CycleVLA: Proactive Self-Correcting Vision-Language-Action Models via Subtask Backtracking and Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
summary: Current work on robot failure detection and correction typically operates in a post hoc manner, analyzing errors and applying corrections only after failures occur. This work introduces CycleVLA, a system that equips Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) with proactive self-correction, the capability to anticipate incipient failures and recover before they fully manifest during execution. CycleVLA achieves this by integrating a progress-aware VLA that flags critical subtask transition points where failures most frequently occur, a VLM-based failure predictor and planner that triggers subtask backtracking upon predicted failure, and a test-time scaling strategy based on Minimum Bayes Risk (MBR) decoding to improve retry success after backtracking. Extensive experiments on the LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus simulation benchmarks show that CycleVLA surpasses the state-of-the-art VLA π0.5, improves success rates by correcting execution failures across VLAs of varying capability, from under-trained ones to fully converged policies, and that MBR serves as an effective zero-shot test-time scaling strategy for VLAs. On a real robot, CycleVLA reaches a 91% average success rate on one precise and two long-horizon manipulation tasks. We further conduct stress tests with multiple manually injected perturbations (e.g., swapping in a distractor at the expected location while relocating the true target object mid-execution), where CycleVLA corrects ~80% of injected failures and maintains success rates comparable to unperturbed execution. Project Page: https://dannymcy.github.io/cyclevla/

title: Controllable LLM Reasoning via Sparse Autoencoder-Based Steering
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) exhibit human-like cognitive reasoning strategies (\eg backtracking, cross-verification) during the reasoning process, which improves their performance on complex tasks. Currently, reasoning strategies are autonomously selected by LRMs themselves. However, such autonomous selection often produces inefficient or even erroneous reasoning paths. To make reasoning more reliable and flexible, it is important to develop methods for controlling reasoning strategies. Existing methods struggle to control fine-grained reasoning strategies due to conceptual entanglement in LRMs' hidden states. To address this, we leverage Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to decompose strategy-entangled hidden states into a disentangled feature space. To identify the few strategy-specific features from the vast pool of SAE features, we propose SAE-Steering, an efficient two-stage feature identification pipeline. SAE-Steering first recalls features that amplify the logits of strategy-specific keywords, filtering out over 99\% of features, and then ranks the remaining features by their control effectiveness. Using the identified strategy-specific features as control vectors, SAE-Steering outperforms existing methods by over 15\% in control effectiveness. Furthermore, controlling reasoning strategies can redirect LRMs from erroneous paths to correct ones, achieving a 7\% absolute accuracy improvement. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Peter-Fy/SAE-Steering.

title: Fundamental Recovery Bounds for SPAD Signals under Stationary Flux
summary: Single-photon avalanche diodes (SPADs) record light as a discrete stream of individual detections. The signal is stochastic. Its statistical structure depends on the sensor's operation mode: binary detection in fixed bins, timestamped detection in fixed bins, or free-running timestamped detection. We derive the likelihood score function for each of these three passive modes. From this single object, stem both fundamental limits of recovery (Cramer-Rao bounds) and practical recovery algorithms based on diffusion posterior sampling. The paper further generalizes fundamental limits to Bayesian Cramer-Rao lower bounds. This generalization makes use of a learned approximation of the score function of signal priors. In prior art, analyses and diffusion-based reconstruction for SPAD data have treated individual modes in isolation. Our unified treatment shows a qualitative high-flux gap between modes: binary counts saturate exponentially, while timestamped modes degrade only linearly. We further extend diffusion posterior sampling, previously restricted to binary SPAD data, to a full timestamped case using the suitable score function. We demonstrate experimentally that matching the score to the operation mode is beneficial for high-fidelity reconstruction. By tying the recovery bounds and diffusion to the score function, this work aims to establish a common foundation for both asking what is recoverable in single-photon sensing, and building methods that approach the bound.

title: Hiding Liker Identity Did Not Increase Engagement With Reputationally Risky Content on X (Formerly Twitter)
summary: In June 2024, X (formerly Twitter) made likes from public to private, offering a rare, platform-level opportunity to study how the visibility of engagement signals affects users' behavior. Here, we investigate whether hiding liker identities increases the number of likes received by high-reputational-risk content, content for which public endorsement may carry high social or reputational costs due to its topic (e.g., politics) or the account context in which it appears (e.g., partisan accounts). To this end, we conduct two complementary studies: 1) a Difference-in-Differences analysis of 153,704 posts that are created by 1045 accounts and have received over 324 million likes on X (formerly Twitter) before and after the policy change; 2) a within-subject survey experiment with 203 X (formerly Twitter) users on participants' self-reported willingness to like different kinds of content. We find no detectable platform-level increase in likes for high-reputational-risk content (Study 1). Additionally, while participants in the survey experiment, particularly those with higher education and income, report modest increases in willingness to like high-reputational-risk content under private versus public visibility, these increases do not lead to significant changes in the group-level average likelihood of liking posts (Study 2). Taken together, our results suggest that hiding liker identity produces a limited behavioral response at the platform level, which may be caused by a gap between user intention and behavior.

title: Measuring the State of Open Science in Transportation Using Large Language Models
summary: Open science initiatives have strengthened scientific integrity and accelerated research progress across many fields, but the state of their practice within transportation research remains under-investigated. Key features of open science, defined here as data and code availability, are difficult to extract due to the inherent complexity of the field. Previous work has either been limited to small-scale studies due to the labor-intensive nature of manual analysis or has relied on large-scale bibliometric approaches that sacrifice contextual richness. This paper introduces an automatic and scalable feature-extraction pipeline to measure code and data availability in transportation research. We employ Large Language Models (LLMs) for this task and validate their performance against a manually curated dataset and through an inter-rater agreement analysis. We applied this pipeline to examine 10,724 research articles published in the Transportation Research Part series of journals between 2019 and 2024. Our analysis found that only 5% of quantitative papers shared a code repository, 4% of quantitative papers shared a data repository, and about 3% of papers shared both, with trends differing across journals, topics, and geographic regions. We found no significant difference in citation counts or review duration between papers that provided data and code and those that did not, suggesting a misalignment between open science efforts and traditional academic metrics. Consequently, encouraging these practices will likely require structural interventions from journals and funding agencies to supplement the lack of direct author incentives. The pipeline developed in this study can be readily scaled to other journals, representing a critical step toward the automated measurement and monitoring of open science practices in transportation research.

title: Beyond Factual Accuracy: Evaluating Global Reasoning Integrity in RAG Systems with LogicScore
summary: Current evaluation methods for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) suffer from \textit{factual myopia}: they relentlessly emphasize factual accuracy yet neglect global logical integrity in long-form answer generation. This drives models to force unnatural connections, producing factually grounded yet logically incoherent responses with unaddressed gaps, ambiguous links, or redundant premises. To mitigate this, we present \textsc{LogicScore}, shifting from local, fact-by-fact assessment to rigorous global reasoning scrutiny. Grounded in Horn Rules, our approach integrates a backward verification mechanism to systematically evaluate three key reasoning dimensions: \textit{Completeness} (logically sound deduction), \textit{Essentiality} (non-redundancy), and \textit{Determinateness} (consistent answer entailment). Extensive experiments across three multi-hop QA datasets (HotpotQA, MusiQue, and 2WikiMultiHopQA) and over 20 LLMs (including GPT-5, Gemini-3-Pro, LLaMA3, and task-specific tuned models) reveal a critical capability gap: leading models often achieve high factual accuracy (e.g., 92.85\% precision for Gemini-3 Pro) but struggle with global reasoning quality (e.g., 35.11\% Essentiality for Gemini-3 Pro). Our work establishes a robust standard for logical evaluation, highlighting the need to prioritize reasoning coherence alongside factual grounding in LLM development.

title: Benchmarking Deep Learning Models for Raman Spectroscopy Across Open-Source Datasets
comments: 20 pages, 4 figures. Substantially revised following peer review including additional baselines, five independent evaluation runs, expanded reproducibility details and confusion matrices. Published in Digital Discovery
summary: Deep learning classifiers for Raman spectroscopy are increasingly reported to outperform classical chemometric approaches. However, their evaluations are often conducted in isolation or compared against traditional machine learning methods or trivially adapted vision-based architectures that were not originally proposed for Raman spectroscopy. As a result, direct comparisons between existing deep learning models developed specifically for Raman spectral analysis on shared open-source datasets remain scarce. In this work, we focus on supervised Raman spectra classification where each spectrum is assigned to a predefined material, bacterial/yeast isolate, drug treatment or pharmaceutical compound. To the best of our knowledge, this study presents one of the first benchmarks comparing three or more published Raman-specific deep learning classifiers across multiple open-source Raman datasets. We evaluate five representative Deep Learning (DL) architectures along with two conventional Machine Learning (ML) methods under a unified training and hyperparameter tuning protocol across three open-source Raman datasets selected to support standard evaluation, fine-tuning, and explicit distribution-shift testing. In this comparative study, we primarily focus on classification because the selected open-source datasets provide classification annotations, while annotations for complete structure elucidation are not available. We report classification accuracies and macro-averaged F1 scores to provide a fair and reproducible comparison of the supervised ML and DL models for Raman spectra based classification.

title: Depth to Anatomy: Organ Localization from Depth Images for Automated Patient Table Positioning in Radiology Workflow
comments: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:024
summary: In clinical radiology, accurate patient table positioning is essential to align specific internal organs of interest with the scanner imaging isocenter, ensuring image quality and diagnostic reliability. Automated patient positioning can streamline this process and improve radiology workflow efficiency by reducing the time required for manual table adjustments and scout-based scan planning. We propose a learning-based framework that predicts 3D organ locations and shapes for 41 anatomical structures, including both bones and soft tissues, directly from a single 2D depth image of the body surface. Leveraging $10,020$ whole-body MRI scans from the German National Cohort (NAKO) dataset, we synthetically generate depth images paired with anatomical segmentations to train a convolutional neural network for volumetric organ prediction. Our method achieves a mean dice similarity coefficient of $0.44\pm0.2$ and and a symmetric average surface distance of $7.69\pm5.68$ mm across all structures. Furthermore, the model derives organ bounding boxes with a mean absolute detection offset of $10.99\pm5.54$ mm. Qualitative results on real-world depth images indicate the ability of the model to generalize to practical clinical settings. These findings suggest that depth-only organ localization can support automated patient positioning reducing setup time, minimizing operator variability, and improving patient comfort.

title: Vector-Valued Distributional Reinforcement Learning Policy Evaluation: A Hilbert Space Embedding Approach
summary: We propose an (offline) multi-dimensional distributional reinforcement learning framework (KE-DRL) that leverages Hilbert space mappings to estimate the kernel mean embedding of the multi-dimensional value distribution under a proposed target policy. In our setting, the state-action variables are multi-dimensional and continuous. By mapping probability measures into a reproducing kernel Hilbert space via kernel mean embeddings, our method replaces Wasserstein metrics with an integral probability metric. This enables efficient estimation in multi-dimensional state-action spaces and reward settings, where direct computation of Wasserstein distances is computationally challenging. Theoretically, we establish contraction properties of the distributional Bellman operator under our proposed metric involving the Matern family of kernels and provide uniform convergence guarantees. Simulations and empirical results demonstrate robust off-policy evaluation and recovery of the kernel mean embedding under mild assumptions, namely, Lipschitz continuity and boundedness of the kernels, highlighting the potential of embedding-based approaches in complex real-world decision-making scenarios and risk evaluation.

title: HeatACO: A Heatmap-Guided Max--Min Ant System for Large-Scale Travelling Salesman Problems
summary: Non-autoregressive neural solvers predict an edge-confidence heatmap for the Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) in one forward pass, but a decoder must still produce a feasible Hamiltonian cycle. As instance size grows, this stage must reconcile a quadratic number of edge scores with global tour constraints. Greedy edge merging is fast and deterministic but produces low-quality tours, whereas Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) over k-opt moves recovers better tours at high computational cost and requires predictor-specific tuning. We propose HeatACO, a predictor-agnostic heatmap-to-tour decoder. Its key is a capped, degree-aware evidence factor that integrates a fixed heatmap into a Max--Min Ant System (MMAS). The factor rewards only edge confidence beyond a node's tour-degree capacity, and its strength is scaled automatically from the pheromone dynamic range, allowing one configuration to decode heatmaps from different predictors without retraining or per-predictor tuning. Across four heatmap sources, HeatACO produces higher-quality solutions in less decoding time than the MCTS baseline on TSP500, TSP1K and TSP10K. Against matched standard MMAS baselines with the same search budget, heatmap guidance improves construction for all four predictors at both scales and remains beneficial with local search. HeatACO also transfers competitively to several distribution shifts and the asymmetric TSP (ATSP). Our post-hoc analysis identifies measurable heatmap properties associated with the observed performance variation.

title: Regime-Adaptive Bayesian Optimization via Dirichlet Process Mixtures of Gaussian Processes
summary: Standard Bayesian Optimization (BO) assumes uniform smoothness across the search space an assumption violated in multi-regime problems such as molecular conformation search through distinct energy basins or drug discovery across heterogeneous molecular scaffolds. A single GP either oversmooths sharp transitions or hallucinates noise in smooth regions, yielding miscalibrated uncertainty. We propose RAMBO, a Dirichlet Process Mixture of Gaussian Processes that automatically discovers latent regimes during optimization, each modeled by an independent GP with locally-optimized hyperparameters. We derive collapsed Gibbs sampling that analytically marginalizes latent functions for efficient inference, and introduce adaptive concentration parameter scheduling for coarse-to-fine regime discovery. Our acquisition functions decompose uncertainty into intra-regime and inter-regime components. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks and real-world applications, including molecular conformer optimization, virtual screening for drug discovery, and fusion reactor design, demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art baselines on multi-regime objectives.

title: A locking-free mixed virtual element discretization for the two dimensional elasticity eigenvalue problem
summary: In this paper, we propose and analyze a mixed virtual element method for the approximation of the eigenvalues and eigenfunctions of the two-dimensional elasticity eigenvalue problem. Under standard assumptions on polygonal meshes, we prove the convergence of the discrete solution operator to its continuous counterpart as the mesh size tends to zero. Relying on the spectral theory of compact operators, we establish the spectral correctness of the method and derive error estimates for both eigenvalues and eigenfunctions. A series of numerical experiments is presented to support the theoretical analysis. The results confirm the predicted convergence rates and show that the method is locking-free and able to approximate the spectrum accurately, independently of the shape of the polygonal elements in the mesh.

title: DSCD-Nav: Dual-Stance Cooperative Debate for Object Navigation
summary: Adaptive navigation in unfamiliar indoor environments is crucial for household service robots.
