title: Forecasting Ionospheric Irregularities on GNSS Lines of Sight Using Dynamic Graphs with Ephemeris Conditioning
comments: 17 pages, 8 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: Most data-driven ionospheric models operate on gridded products, which do not preserve the time-varying sampling structure of satellite-based sensing. We instead model the ionosphere as a dynamic graph over ionospheric pierce points, with connectivity that evolves as satellite positions change. Because satellite trajectories are predictable, the graph topology over the forecast horizon can be constructed in advance. We exploit this property to condition forecasts on the future graph structure, which we term ephemeris conditioning. This enables prediction on lines of sight (LoS) that appear only in the forecast horizon. We evaluate our framework on Global Navigation Satellite System data from a co-located receiver pair in Singapore spanning 2023 to 2025. The task is forecasting irregularities defined by the Rate of TEC Index (ROTI) up to 2 hours ahead as per-node binary classification. The resulting model, IonoDGNN, achieves a Brier Skill Score (BSS) of 0.55 and an area under the precision-recall curve (PR-AUC) of 0.77. These correspond to improvements over persistence of 53% in BSS and 58% in PR-AUC, with larger gains at longer lead times. Ablations confirm that graph structure and ephemeris conditioning each contribute meaningfully. Under simulated coverage dropout, the model retains predictive skill on affected nodes through spatial message passing from observed neighbors. Compared to interpolation baselines, the proposed model achieves better recovery, especially at higher dropout levels. These results suggest that dynamic graph forecasting on evolving LoS is a viable alternative for ionospheric modeling. The project and the dataset are available at https://github.com/Mert-chan/IonoDGNN.
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing

title: Structured Scaling of AI Discovery Across Diverse Scientific Domains
summary: Scientific discovery often requires many cycles of proposing, testing, and refining candidate solutions. Language models can increasingly participate in these loops, but simply generating more attempts does not ensure progress: parallel searches may duplicate one another and iterative refinement may become trapped in poor directions. The central challenge is therefore not only to scale AI-driven discovery, but to structure that scaling so that evaluation signals compound over time. Here we introduce SimpleTES (Simple Test-time Evaluation-driven Scaling), a framework that focuses on the structured scaling of AI discovery loops, organizing evaluator queries across independent trajectories, iterative refinement, local candidate selection, and the selective reuse of evaluated histories. Drawing on structural features of scientific communities, SimpleTES uses a single open-source GPT-OSS model to establish new state-of-the-art solutions across 28 open-ended problems in diverse scientific domains ranging from quantum physics and astronomy to biology, AI, and mathematics. These include a 24.5% reduction in quantum circuit compilation overhead, up to 23% lower propulsive cost for deep-space trajectories, a 2.17x faster lasso-path solver, an 8.5% lower-error whole-brain neural-activity predictor, the fastest reported TriMul kernel, and new mathematical constructions beyond prior human or AI records. We further post-train the model for long-horizon discovery by assigning each attempt the final outcome of the trajectory it helped produce. This improves performance on both training and held-out mathematics problems, further advancing the frontier. Together, these results establish structured scaling as a general mechanism for advancing AI scientific discovery.

title: Decoding Delay Guarantees of Space Regulated Multiple Access Random Wireless Networks using Successive Interference Cancellation
summary: This paper is focused on decoding delay guarantees in wireless networks, where messages have a given signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio threshold $η_0$ to meet in order to be successfully decoded, and where transmissions should occur within some strict time constraints. Its main contribution consists in quantifying the worst-case transmissions decoding delays in the uplink of cellular and cell-free networks using successive interference cancellation. We show how such decoding delay guarantees can be obtained using spatial network calculus, a new tool introduced recently, and in particular spatial regulation. The results rely on the assumption of absence of fading. We nevertheless outline what this approach will lead to in the fading case for cellular networks.

title: Why Does Grounding Hurt Medical VQA? Benchmarking, Diagnosis, and Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly applied to medical visual question answering (Med-VQA), yet whether they can \emph{localize} the evidence behind their answers---a prerequisite for clinical auditability---is poorly characterized. We separately evaluate VQA reasoning and visual grounding for four recent frontier VLMs (GPT-5.1, GPT-5.5, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Gemini-3-Flash), two domain-specific medical VLMs (Lingshu, MedGemma), and a dedicated open-vocabulary detector (Grounding DINO) on VQA-RAD and SLAKE. Two findings challenge the intuition that ``add grounding to improve VQA.'' First, \textbf{no model localizes medical targets well}: every off-the-shelf system---frontier, medical-specialized, or dedicated detector---scores mean IoU 0.05--0.24 on our SLAKE grounding split, at or barely above a trivial center-box baseline (0.10), with Acc@0.5 below 20\%. Second, and counter to the common ``localize-then-answer'' paradigm, \textbf{cropping to a bounding box degrades VQA even when the box is a perfect oracle}: on the matched subset where oracle ground-truth boxes are applied, GT-grounding \emph{lowers} closed-ended accuracy for every model (by 0.9--18.0 points versus using the full image)---consistent with the crop discarding global context the model relies on. Because the oracle box removes localization error by construction, the problem is not that perception is a recoverable bottleneck, but that grounding-by-cropping is itself the wrong interface. Finally, we show constructively that the two channels need not conflict: supervised fine-tuning of Qwen-2.5-VL-7B on answers \emph{alone} silently destroys box-evidence emission (0/418 parseable boxes), whereas mixing in a small amount of grounding supervision restores localization to 0.36 IoU---above every zero-shot model---while preserving answer accuracy.

title: Demographic-Aware Transfer Learning for Sleep Stage Classification in Clinical Polysomnography
summary: Automated sleep stage classification typically employs a single population-agnostic model, disregarding established demographic variations in sleep architecture. Sleep patterns, however, differ substantially across gender, age, and obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) severity, indicating that a onesize-fits all approach may be suboptimal for diverse clinical populations. In this paper, we propose a two stage training strategy based on demographic stratification and transfer learning framework. We first pretrains a convolutional recurrent model on the full population and then fine tunes it independently for demographic subgroups defined by gender, age, and Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI) severity according to the AASM clinical standard. Using the DREAMT dataset comprising 100 clinical subjects and 7 PSG channels, we evaluate 37 fine-tuned configurations across single-axis and two-way demographic combinations. Results demonstrate that 35 of the 37 fine-tuned models outperform the baseline, with Cohen's kappa improvements ranging from 0.9 to 12.9%. These findings indicate that stratified fine tuning tailored to specific patient demographics yields substantially more accurate sleep staging than a single generalized model, offering a practical and clinically grounded paradigm for personalized sleep assessment.

AI.title_translation: 临床多导睡眠图睡眠阶段分类中感知人口统计特征的迁移学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合人口统计学分层与迁移学习的两阶段睡眠分期框架，通过对不同性别、年龄和OSA严重程度亚组进行针对性微调，显著提升了睡眠阶段分类的准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统的自动化睡眠阶段分类通常采用单一的通用模型，忽略了不同性别、年龄和阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）严重程度患者之间睡眠结构的显著差异，这种“一刀切”的方法在多样化的临床人群中并非最优。
AI.method: 提出一种两阶段训练策略：首先在全人群数据上预训练一个卷积循环模型（Convolutional Recurrent Model），然后根据AASM临床标准，按性别、年龄和AHI严重程度划分人口统计学亚组，对其进行独立微调。基于包含100名临床受试者和7个PSG通道的DREAMT数据集，对37种单轴及双向人口统计组合配置进行了评估。
AI.result: 评估的37个微调模型中有35个表现优于基线模型，Cohen's kappa系数提高了0.9%至12.9%。
AI.conclusion: 针对患者具体的人口统计特征进行分层微调，相比单一的通用模型能够大幅提升睡眠分期的准确性，为临床个性化睡眠评估提供了一种实用且有临床依据的新范式。
AI.translation: 自动睡眠阶段分类通常采用单一的与人群无关的模型，忽视了睡眠结构中已明确的人口统计学差异。然而，睡眠模式在性别、年龄和阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）严重程度之间存在显著差异，这表明“一刀切”的方法对于多样化的临床人群可能是次优的。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于人口统计学分层和迁移学习框架的两阶段训练策略。我们首先在全人群上预训练一个卷积循环模型，然后根据AASM临床标准，针对按性别、年龄和呼吸暂停低通气指数（AHI）严重程度定义的人口统计亚组分别进行独立微调。使用包含100名临床受试者和7个PSG通道的DREAMT数据集，我们评估了涵盖单轴和双向人口统计组合的37种微调配置。结果表明，37个微调模型中有35个优于基线模型，Cohen's kappa改进幅度在0.9%到12.9%之间。这些发现表明，针对特定患者人口统计特征量身定制的分层微调比单一通用模型能获得显著更准确的睡眠分期，为个性化睡眠评估提供了一种实用且有临床依据的范式。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种结合人口统计学分层与迁移学习的两阶段睡眠阶段分类框架。该方法先在全人群数据上预训练卷积循环模型，再根据性别、年龄和AHI严重程度划分亚组进行针对性微调。实验表明，绝大多数分层微调模型在睡眠分期准确率上均显著超越传统通用基线模型。
AI.keywords: 睡眠阶段分类, 迁移学习, 人口统计学分层, 多导睡眠图, 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于打破了传统睡眠分期模型“一刀切”的盲目假设，将年龄、性别及OSA严重程度等临床人口统计学因素融入迁移学习的微调阶段，具有很高的临床应用和个性化医疗价值。局限性在于实验仅基于包含100名受试者的DREAMT数据集，样本量相对较小，未来需要在更大规模、更多中心的数据集上验证其泛化能力。

title: Convolutional Neural Networks in Vis-NIR Chemometrics: From Contradiction to Conditional Design
summary: Near-infrared (NIR and Vis-NIR) spectroscopy is widely used for rapid, non-destructive analysis in food, agriculture, pharmaceuticals, process analytical technology, and bioprocess monitoring. Nevertheless, deep-learning studies in NIR chemometrics often reach conflicting conclusions about convolutional neural network (CNN) design, including kernel size, depth, preprocessing, model complexity, and transfer robustness. This review argues that many apparent contradictions reflect incomplete experimental conditioning rather than incompatible findings. CNN performance depends on interactions among spectral physics, dataset regime, acquisition protocol, validation design, and deployment conditions. We organize the literature around three moderators. First, NIR signals are indirect, highly collinear, and shaped by broad overlapping bands, scattering, temperature, and matrix effects. Second, CNN design should be interpreted through receptive-field reasoning: kernel size, depth, dilation, and multi-scale branches determine the wavelength span available to the model, whereas the effective receptive field indicates which parts are actually used. Third, validation design can behave as a hidden hyperparameter because random splits may reward architectures that exploit shared batch, instrument, season, or process-run structure instead of transferable chemical information. We therefore propose a conditional design framework in which preprocessing, architecture, hyperparameter optimization, transfer evaluation, interpretability, and reproducibility are treated as coupled components. Rather than seeking a universally optimal CNN, the framework aims to support physics-aware, shift-aware, and reproducible model comparison in NIR chemometrics.

AI.title_translation: Vis-NIR化学计量学中的卷积神经网络：从矛盾到条件设计
AI.tldr: 本文指出了NIR光谱分析中CNN设计结论冲突的根本原因在于实验条件的不完整，并提出了一种结合光谱物理与感受野推理的“条件设计框架”以指导规范化的模型比较。
AI.motivation: 近红外（NIR和Vis-NIR）光谱分析中的深度学习研究在卷积神经网络（CNN）设计（如卷积核大小、深度、预处理、模型复杂度及迁移稳健性）方面经常得出相互矛盾的结论。本文旨在厘清这些由实验条件设定不完整导致的表面矛盾，为CNN在NIR化学计量学中的应用提供系统化的设计指导。
AI.method: 本文从光谱物理特性、感受野推理和验证设计三个调节因素梳理相关文献，并提出了一种将预处理、网络架构、超参数优化、迁移评估、可解释性与可复现性视为耦合组件的“条件设计框架”（Conditional Design Framework）。
AI.result: 揭示了CNN性能取决于光谱物理特性、数据集体制、采集协议、验证设计与部署条件之间的相互作用；明确了感受野对波长利用率的决定作用，以及随机划分数据集可能导致模型误用批次/仪器等共享信息而非可迁移化学信息的风险。
AI.conclusion: 放弃寻找通用的最优CNN网络架构，转而建立包含物理感知、漂移感知和高可复现性的条件设计框架，以进行更严谨和科学的模型比较。
AI.translation: 近红外（NIR和Vis-NIR）光谱技术广泛用于食品、农业、医药、过程分析技术和生物过程监控中的快速无损分析。然而，NIR化学计量学中的深度学习研究在卷积神经网络（CNN）设计（包括卷积核大小、深度、预处理、模型复杂度和迁移稳健性）方面经常得出相互矛盾的结论。本综述认为，许多表面上的矛盾反映的是实验条件设定不完整，而非结论本身不可调和。CNN的性能取决于光谱物理特性、数据集体制、采集协议、验证设计和部署条件之间的相互作用。我们将相关文献围绕三个调节因素进行梳理：首先，NIR信号具有间接性、高度共线性的特点，并受宽重叠波段、散射、温度和基质效应的影响。其次，CNN设计应通过感受野推理进行解释：卷积核大小、深度、膨胀率和多尺度分支决定了模型可用的波长跨度，而有效感受野则指明了实际使用了哪些部分。第三，验证设计可能会充当隐藏的超参数，因为随机划分可能会奖赏那些利用了共享批次、仪器、季节或过程运行结构而非可迁移化学信息的网络架构。因此，我们提出了一种条件设计框架，其中预处理、网络架构、超参数优化、迁移评估、可解释性和可复现性被视为耦合的组件。该框架旨在支持NIR化学计量学中具有物理感知、漂移感知且可复现的模型比较，而非寻求普遍最优的CNN。
AI.summary: 本文针对Vis-NIR化学计量学中CNN模型设计结论互相冲突的现状，深入分析了光谱信号特性、感受野推理以及验证设计对模型性能的影响，提出了一种将预处理、架构设计、评估与可解释性等要素紧密耦合的“条件设计框架”，为实现物理感知、分布偏移感知及高可复现性的光谱深度学习模型比较奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 近红外光谱, 卷积神经网络, 化学计量学, 条件设计框架, 感受野推理
AI.comments: 本文创新性地从“感受野推理”和“验证设计漏洞”等视角重新审视了近红外光谱深度学习研究中常见的矛盾结论，指出了随机划分数据集可能导致的评估偏差。提出的条件设计框架强调将光谱物理特性、网络架构与评估方式进行耦合，具有很强的实用价值和学术启发意义，有助于推动化学计量学深度学习研究从盲目追求通用架构转向系统化、物理知情的方向。

title: Fully Automatic Trace Gas Plume Detection
comments: Manuscript 15 pages + 3 in supplementary, 10 figures, 1 table, more in attached supplementary; In review
summary: Future imaging spectrometers will expand contemporary data volumes by orders of magnitude, requiring automated methods to upscale labor-intensive detection of trace gas point sources. Here we present a fully-automated approach that achieves operational performance for plume detection and labelling without human participation. Our method combines machine learning (ML)-based morphological analysis with physics-based spectroscopic model fitting. We deploy it on data from the EMIT imaging spectrometer, operating in two modes. First, we present a "daily digest" that runs automatically on all downlinked data, flagging the largest events for immediate response. The daily digest demonstrates that a significant fraction of the largest plumes can be detected automatically with negligible false positives. This represents a significant new high-water mark in plume detection accuracy. Second, we use it for retrospective analysis to find plumes that were missed by the existing human review process. We observe that at least 25% of large plumes may have been passed over in the existing workflow due to confirmation bias and ambiguity in the visual cues used by human reviewers. Finally, we extend detection to three understudied trace gases: NH3, NO2 and the first observations of carbon monoxide (CO) plume in EMIT imagery.
comment: Manuscript 15 pages + 3 in supplementary, 10 figures, 1 table, more in attached supplementary; In review

AI.title_translation: 全自动微量气体羽流检测
AI.tldr: 提出了结合机器学习形态学分析与光谱物理拟合的全自动微量气体羽流检测方法，极大地降低了假阳性并纠正了25%以上的人工漏检。
AI.motivation: 未来的成像光谱仪将产生海量数据，依赖人工审核的微量气体点源检测方法效率低下且易受确认偏误与视觉歧义影响，亟需全自动化的检测方法来提升处理能力与准确性。
AI.method: 结合基于机器学习（ML）的形态学分析与基于物理的光谱模型拟合，并在EMIT成像光谱仪数据上部署了“每日摘要”（实时标记最大事件）和“回顾性分析”（排查人工遗漏羽流）两种运行模式。
AI.result: 1. “每日摘要”模式能在极低假阳性率下自动检测出大部分最大羽流，树立了羽流检测精度的标杆；2. 回顾性分析发现现有人工审核流程遗漏了至少25%的大型羽流；3. 拓展检测到了NH3、NO2，并首次在EMIT图像中观察到一氧化碳（CO）羽流。
AI.conclusion: 该全自动检测方法无需人工干预即可达到业务化运行标准，不仅显著提高了微量气体羽流检测的效率与精度，还弥补了人工审核的缺陷，并成功拓展至更多微量气体的监测。
AI.translation: 未来的成像光谱仪将使现有数据量增加几个数量级，因此需要自动化方法来扩展原本耗费大量人力对微量气体点源进行的检测。在此，我们提出了一种无需人工参与即可实现羽流检测和标记的业务化性能的全自动方法。我们的方法将基于机器学习（ML）的形态学分析与基于物理的光谱模型拟合相结合。我们将该方法部署在EMIT成像光谱仪的数据上，以两种模式运行。首先，我们展示了一种“每日摘要”模式，该模式对所有下行数据自动运行，标记出最大的事件以供即时响应。“每日摘要”表明，很大一部分最大的羽流可以被自动检测出来，且假阳性极低。这代表了羽流检测准确性上的一个重要新标杆。其次，我们将其用于回顾性分析，以发现现有人工审核流程中所错过的羽流。我们观察到，由于人工审核员使用的视觉线索存在确认偏误和歧义，在现有工作流程中至少有25%的大型羽流可能被忽略了。最后，我们将检测扩展到了三种未被充分研究的微量气体：NH3、NO2，以及首次在EMIT图像中观察到的一氧化碳（CO）羽流。
AI.summary: 本文针对海量遥感光谱数据处理的需求，提出了一种结合机器学习形态分析与光谱物理模型拟合的全自动微量气体羽流检测方法。该方法在EMIT光谱仪数据上实现了实时高精度预警（假阳性极低）和回顾性查漏（纠正了人工流程中25%以上的漏检），并拓展了对NH3、NO2及CO等多种微量气体的检测能力。
AI.keywords: 微量气体检测, 羽流识别, 成像光谱仪, 机器学习, 遥感自动化
AI.comments: 该研究成功结合了数据驱动的机器学习形态学分析与基于物理的光谱拟合方法，兼顾了检测效率与物理可解释性，突破了面对海量遥感数据时人工标注微量气体羽流的瓶颈。其实时“每日摘要”模式展现了极高的工程应用价值，且揭示并弥补了人工审核中高达25%的遗漏率，具有重要现实意义。局限性在于，文摘中未详细说明算法在极小羽流或复杂地表背景下的检测下限及泛化性能。

title: The Scaling Properties of Implicit Deductive Reasoning in Transformers
summary: We investigate the scaling properties of implicit deductive reasoning over Horn clauses in depth-bounded Transformers. By systematically decorrelating provability from spurious features and enforcing algorithmic alignment, we find that in sufficiently deep models with a bidirectional prefix mask, implicit reasoning approaches explicit CoT performance across graph topologies and problem widths, though CoT remains necessary for depth extrapolation.

AI.title_translation: Transformer中隐式演绎推理的缩放特性
AI.tldr: 在足够深且采用双向前缀掩码的Transformer中，隐式推理性能可接近显式思维链（CoT），但深度外推仍依赖CoT。
AI.motivation: 探索深度受限的Transformer模型在霍恩子句（Horn clauses）上隐式演绎推理的缩放特性，并评估隐式推理能否达到显式思维链（CoT）的性能水平。
AI.method: 通过系统性地解耦可证明性与伪特征，实施算法对齐，并在深度受限的Transformer中使用双向前缀掩码（bidirectional prefix mask）。
AI.result: 在足够深且采用双向前缀掩码的模型中，隐式推理在各种图拓扑和问题宽度上均能接近显式思维链（CoT）的性能；但在深度外推任务中，CoT仍不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 隐式演绎推理可以在模型足够深且具备合适架构设计的情况下逼近显式思维链的性能，但要实现超出训练深度的推广（深度外推），显式CoT仍然是必需的。
AI.translation: 我们研究了深度受限的Transformer在霍恩子句上隐式演绎推理的缩放特性。通过系统地将可证明性与伪特征解耦并实施算法对齐，我们发现，在具有双向前缀掩码且足够深的模型中，隐式推理在各种图拓扑和问题宽度上都接近显式思维链（CoT）的性能，尽管对于深度外推而言，CoT仍然是必要的。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了深度受限Transformer在霍恩子句上进行隐式演绎推理的缩放属性。研究表明，通过解除伪特征关联并进行算法对齐，带有双向前缀掩码的足够深的Transformer可以在不同图拓扑和宽度上展现出接近显式思维链（CoT）的隐式推理能力，尽管进行深度外推时依然需要CoT。
AI.keywords: Implicit Reasoning, Deductive Reasoning, Transformers, Scaling Properties, Chain-of-Thought
AI.comments: 本文探讨了Transformer在无需显式思维链（CoT）情况下的隐式推理能力边界及其缩放规律，揭示了深度与注意力掩码对推理性能的关键作用，同时也明确指出了隐式推理在深度外推上的局限性，对理解语言模型的推理机制具有重要价值。

title: AlphaCrafter: Harnessing Multi-Agent Workflows for Cross-Sectional Quantitative Trading
summary: Quantitative trading agents have demonstrated substantial promise in automating factor discovery, signal aggregation, and portfolio execution. However, existing agent-based trading systems predominantly rely on loosely specified natural-language workflows, leading to opaque reasoning processes, inconsistent behaviors across foundation models, and limited controllability and verifiability, all of which introduce significant risks in financial decision-making. To address these limitations, we propose AlphaCrafter, a multi-agent framework built upon a structured agent harness. Instead of treating agent behavior as unconstrained prompt execution, AlphaCrafter encapsulates each agent within programmable policy specifications that integrate procedural workflows, execution constraints, and explicit verification mechanisms. This harness-driven design transforms the entire trading pipeline into a sequence of well-defined, reproducible, and auditable decision processes with explicit execution semantics. Extensive experiments on the CSI 300 and S&P 500 benchmarks demonstrate that AlphaCrafter consistently achieves superior risk-adjusted returns while exhibiting substantially lower cross-model and cross-trial variance. These results suggest that harness-based agent design provides a practical foundation for building more reliable, controllable, and robust multi-agent systems for quantitative trading.

AI.title_translation: AlphaCrafter：构建用于截面量化交易的多智能体工作流框架
AI.tldr: AlphaCrafter 引入了结构化的智能体驾驭（harness）机制，将量化交易智能体封装在可编程策略和显式验证约束中，显著提升了截面交易的风险调整收益和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的量化交易智能体系统过度依赖松散的自然语言工作流，导致推理过程不透明、不同基础模型间行为不一致、可控性与可验证性较差，给金融决策带来了显著风险。
AI.method: 提出了 AlphaCrafter 框架，将智能体封装在结合了程序化工作流、执行约束和显式验证机制的可编程策略规范中，把整个交易流程转化为具备明确执行语义、可复现且可审计的决策过程。
AI.result: 在沪深300（CSI 300）和标普500（S&P 500）基准上的测试表明，AlphaCrafter 持续获得了更高的风险调整收益，同时在跨模型和跨试验运行中展现出大幅降低的方差。
AI.conclusion: 基于驾驭机制（harness-based）的智能体设计为构建更可靠、可控和稳健的量化交易多智能体系统提供了实用的技术基础。
AI.translation: 量化交易智能体在自动化因子发现、信号聚合和投资组合执行方面展现出巨大的应用前景。然而，现有的基于智能体的交易系统主要依赖于松散定义的自然语言工作流，导致推理过程不透明、不同基础模型间的行为不一致，以及可控性和可验证性有限，所有这些都给金融决策带来了显著风险。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 AlphaCrafter，这是一个构建在结构化智能体驾驭（agent harness）之上的多智能体框架。AlphaCrafter 不再将智能体行为视为不受约束的提示词执行，而是将每个智能体封装在集成了程序化工作流、执行约束和显式验证机制的可编程策略规范中。这种由驾驭机制驱动的设计将整个交易流程转化为具有明确执行语义的、定义清晰、可复现且可审计的一系列决策过程。在沪深300和标普500基准上的广泛实验表明，AlphaCrafter 持续实现了卓越的风险调整后收益，同时表现出显著更低的跨模型和跨试验方差。这些结果表明，基于驾驭机制的智能体设计为构建更可靠、可控和稳健的量化交易多智能体系统奠定了实用基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 AlphaCrafter 框架，旨在解决基于 LLM 的量化交易智能体因依赖自然语言提示而导致的行为不一致和不可控问题。AlphaCrafter 通过结构化的智能体驾驭（harness）机制，将智能体行为封装在包含可编程策略、执行约束和验证机制的规范中。实验证明，该方法不仅提高了风险调整收益，还显著降低了模型与试验间的方差，增强了系统的稳定性和可审计性。
AI.keywords: 量化交易, 多智能体框架, 智能体驾驭, 截面交易, 风险调整收益
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于抛弃了传统大语言模型量化智能体依赖松散自然语言提示词的模式，引入了结构化、可编程且具备显式验证机制的智能体驾驭（agent harness）架构，大幅提升了系统的可控性与可审计性。其重要性在于为高风险金融决策提供了更稳健、一致性更高且方差更低的解决方案。局限性在于摘要中未透漏策略规范的具体可编程语言细节以及在极端非平稳市场条件下的泛化能力。

title: Sheet As Token: A Graph-Enhanced Representation for Multi-Sheet Spreadsheet Understanding
summary: Workbook-scale spreadsheet understanding is increasingly important for language-model-based data analysis agents, but remains challenging because relevant information is often distributed across multiple sheets with heterogeneous schemas, layouts, and implicit relationships. Existing retrieval-augmented approaches typically decompose spreadsheets into rows, columns, or blocks to improve scalability; however, such chunk-centric representations can fragment worksheets into isolated text spans and weaken global sheet-level semantics. We propose Sheet As Token (SAT), a graph-enhanced framework that treats each worksheet as a unified semantic unit for multi-sheet spreadsheet retrieval. SAT serializes sparse schema-aware features, including sheet name, shape, and column headers, and encodes each worksheet into a compact dense token. Given a query, SAT retrieves candidates with a BGE-initialized Sheet Encoder and refines them with a gated relational GNN. In strict full-corpus evaluation, SAT reaches 0.9173 NDCG@5 on IndustryTab-614 and 0.9222 on IndustryTab-1K, relative improvements of 44.6% and 46.7% over zero-shot BGE RAG, respectively. SAT therefore improves both retrieval accuracy and serving efficiency: on IndustryTab-1K, it exceeds a Qwen3.5-9B RAG reranker by 12.5% while reducing online latency from 2.61 s to 9.24 ms, approximately 283X faster. These results show that SAT provides accurate and latency-efficient retrieval in the evaluated fixed-corpus setting. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SHITIANYU-hue/SheetasToken .

title: FREPix: Frequency-Heterogeneous Flow Matching for Pixel-Space Image Generation
summary: Pixel-space diffusion has re-emerged as a promising alternative to latent-space generation because it avoids the representation bottleneck introduced by VAEs. Yet most existing methods still treat image generation as a frequency-homogeneous process, overlooking the distinct roles and learning dynamics of low- and high-frequency components. To address this, we propose FREPix, a FREquency-heterogeneous flow matching framework for Pixel-space image generation. FREPix explicitly decomposes generation into low- and high-frequency components, assigns them separate transport paths, predicts them with a factorized network, and trains them with a frequency-aware objective. In this way, coarse-to-fine generation becomes an explicit design principle rather than an implicit behavior. On ImageNet class-to-image generation, FREPix achieves competitive results among pixel-space generation models, reaching 1.91 FID at $256\times256$ and 2.38 FID at $512\times512$, with particularly strong performance in the early stages of training and in the low-NFE regime.

title: Rethinking Event-Based Object Dtection through Representation-Level Temporal Aggregation and Model-Level Hypergraph Reasoning
summary: Event cameras provide microsecond-level temporal resolution, low latency, and high dynamic range, offering potential for perception under fast motion and challenging illumination conditions. However, existing Event-based Object Detection (EOD) methods face limitations at both the representation and model levels: prior event representations usually encode temporal information indirectly through redundant structures, while detection models struggle to explicitly aggregate fragmented event responses into coherent high-order object features. To address these limitations, we present \textbf{Event Dual Temporal-Relational Aggregation Detector (Ev-DTAD)}, a unified EOD framework that integrates representation-level temporal encoding with model-level temporal-hypergraph reasoning. Specifically, we introduce \textbf{Hierarchical Temporal Aggregation (HTA)}, a compact three-channel pseudo-RGB representation that explicitly embeds temporal information across intra- and inter-window events. To further enhance detection under sparse and fragmented event responses, we propose \textbf{Frequency-aware Hypergraph Temporal Fusion (FHTF)}, which refines multi-scale event features through temporal evolution modeling and high-order relational reasoning. Extensive experiments on Gen1 (\textbf{+0.8 mAP}), 1Mpx/Gen4 (\textbf{+0.5 mAP}), and eTraM (\textbf{+3.0 mAP}) demonstrate that Ev-DTAD achieves a competitive accuracy--efficiency trade-off, validating the complementarity between compact temporal representation and temporal-hypergraph feature reasoning (Fig.~\ref{fig:bubble}). The code is available at: https://github.com/meisenwang/Ev-DTAD.

title: Complex-Valued Phase-Coherent Transformer
comments: 26 pages, 17 tables (no figures). Companion Lean 4 formalization of Theorems 1 and 2 at https://github.com/leohio/phase-coherent-transformer-r-d
summary:
Complex-valued Transformers have largely inherited softmax attention from real-valued architectures. However, row-normalised token competition is not necessarily aligned with phase-preserving computation. In this paper, we introduce the Phase-Coherent Transformer (PCT), which applies a real-valued, element-independent, smooth gate to L2-normalised complex query-key similarities. PCT replaces token competition with token-non-competing attention and is designed to preserve phase information across layers.
  Across mid-scale benchmarks spanning long-range memory, hierarchical long-range reasoning, positional retrieval, phase-based memory and superposition, and image classification, PCT shows strong generalisation across task categories. Under parameter-fair comparison, PCT consistently outperforms both the standard softmax Transformer and its direct complex-valued counterpart. Moreover, even on tasks traditionally considered difficult for complex-valued neural networks, such as NIAH and LRA-Text, PCT remains competitive with Multiscreen, the strongest real-valued NN baseline in our comparison. Experiments introducing gates that deliberately violate the PCT conditions show that the design is not incidental: smooth gates that preserve negatively aligned phase components remain strong, whereas gates that delete such components collapse on long-range retrieval, and gates whose outputs become excessively large suffer clear performance degradation. PCT also shows no depth-related accuracy collapse across the tested depth range. These results support introducing multi-layer phase-coherent structure into attention as a promising design principle for achieving generalisation in complex-valued Transformers.

title: From Controlled to the Wild: Evaluation of Pentesting Agents for the Real-World
summary: AI pentesting agents are increasingly credible as offensive security systems, but current benchmarks still provide limited guidance on which will perform best in real-world targets. Existing evaluation protocols assess and optimize for predefined goals such as capture-the-flag, remote code execution, exploit reproduction, or trajectory similarity, in simplified or narrow settings. These tools are valuable for measuring bounded capabilities, yet they do not adequately capture the complexity, open-ended exploration, and strategic decision-making required in realistic pentesting. In this paper, we present a practical evaluation protocol that shifts assessment from task completion to validated vulnerability discovery, allowing evaluation in sufficiently complex targets spanning multiple attack surfaces and vulnerability classes. The protocol combines structured ground-truth with LLM-based semantic matching to identify vulnerabilities, bipartite resolution to score findings under realistic ambiguity, continuous ground-truth maintenance, repeated and cumulative evaluation of stochastic agents, efficiency metrics, and reduced-suite selection for sustainable experimentation. This protocol extends the state of the art by enabling a more realistic, operationally informative comparison of AI pentesting agents. To enable reproducibility, we also release expert-annotated ground truth and code for the proposed evaluation protocol: https://github.com/ethiack/ethibench.

title: Nautilus: From One Prompt to Plug-and-Play Robot Learning
summary: Robot learning research is fragmented across policy families, benchmark suites, and real robots; each implementation is entangled with the others in a complex combination matrix, making it an engineering nightmare to port any single element. General-purpose coding agents may occasionally bridge specific setups, but cannot close this gap at scale because they lack the procedural priors and validation practices that characterize robotics research workflows. We propose NAUTILUS, an open-source harness that turns a single user prompt -- for example, "Evaluate policy A with benchmark B" -- into ready-to-use reproduction, evaluation, fine-tuning, and deployment workflows. NAUTILUS provides: plug-and-play agent skill sets with distilled priors from robotics research; typed contracts among policies, simulators/benchmarks, and real-world robots; unified interfaces and execution environments; and a trustworthy agentic coding workflow with explicit, automated validation, and testing at each milestone. NAUTILUS can not only automatically generate the required adapters and containers for existing implementations, but also wrap and onboard new or user-provided policies, simulators/benchmarks, and robots, all connected via a uniform interface. This expands cross-validation coverage without hand-written glue code. Like a nautilus shell that grows by adding chambers, NAUTILUS scales by extending its execution in chambered units, making it a research harness for scalability rather than a hand-curated framework, and aiming to reduce the engineering burden of cross-family reproduction and evaluation in the ever-growing robot learning ecosystem.

title: EBCC: Enclave-Backed Confidential Containers via OCI-Compatible Runtime Integration
summary:
Container runtimes provide a stable operational interface for deploying, monitoring, and controlling modern workloads, while trusted execution environments (TEEs) provide hardware-enforced isolation for sensitive computation. Existing confidential-container systems often rely on VM-backed deployment stacks or TEE-specific execution substrates, which can separate confidential execution from the conventional OCI runtime lifecycle. This paper presents EBCC (Enclave-Backed Confidential Containers), an OCI-compatible runtime architecture for managing composite confidential-computing workloads. EBCC treats the REE-side anchor and TEE-side confidential stages as a single containerized confidential-computing composite, preserves standard OCI lifecycle operations, and keeps TEE-specific execution behind a backend adapter. It also maintains persistent per-instance state and per-stage artifacts for request handling, response generation, logging, and evidence binding.
  We implement EBCC on a Keystone backend and evaluate its correctness, performance, footprint, and concurrent execution behavior. The results show that EBCC introduces additional latency over native Keystone execution, mainly due to lifecycle mediation, request validation, EID allocation, backend dispatch, and artifact persistence, while keeping the added footprint concentrated on host-side management state. Cross-TEE case studies on SGX, TDX, and OP-TEE show that the same lifecycle and stage abstraction can be mapped to enclave-style, VM-style, and embedded-style TEEs. These results indicate that EBCC can make TEE-backed execution manageable through an OCI-style lifecycle without materially enlarging the protected-side TCB.

title: Efficient Online Conformal Selection with Limited Feedback
summary: We address the problem of conformal selection, where an agent must select a low-cost subset of options to ensure that at least one "success" is identified at a pre-specified target rate $φ$. While traditional online conformal prediction focuses on maintaining validity for the observed sequence, minimizing the resource cost (efficiency) of such selections, especially under limited feedback, remains a significant challenge. In this work, we consider highly restricted "bandit" feedback, where the agent only observes feedback about the subset it selected, and not the true label, point, or outcomes of unchosen options. We demonstrate that the simple Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI) update rule, when applied to the appropriate control parameter or dual variable and paired with explicit boundary actions, is both adversarially valid, ensuring the success target is met on average for any input sequence (and hence under distribution shifts), and stochastically efficient, achieving sublinear efficiency regret for i.i.d. inputs against an optimal stochastic benchmark. The key algorithmic idea is to avoid the projected updates standard in constrained bandits: projections break the exact telescoping identity behind ACI validity, whereas boundary actions stabilize the unprojected update through actual decisions. We show these guarantees under canonical models capturing bandit feedback via a unified algorithmic technique and Lyapunov-based analysis. Our approach handles more general settings than prior work, while requiring significantly less feedback, and provides a new theoretical bridge between efficient online learning with limited feedback and distribution-free uncertainty quantification.

title: EAGT: Echocardiography Augmentation for Generalisability and Transferability
summary: Deep learning models for echocardiography segmentation often struggle to generalise across institutions, scanners, and patient populations, where collecting large, consistently annotated datasets is infeasible. Data augmentation is inexpensive and widely used to improve the robustness of deep learning models; however, its role in enhancing cross-dataset generalisability in echocardiography remains insufficiently understood. This study presents a large-scale multi-dataset evaluation of 29 data augmentation techniques and their pairwise combinations for 2D left ventricular segmentation using a U-Net trained on Unity, CAMUS, and EchoNet Dynamic datasets. Each augmentation was explored under several hyperparameter settings and assessed through repeated runs using Dice and IoU in both in-domain and cross-dataset scenarios, with statistical significance quantified via independent t-tests. In-domain accuracy was near-saturated and insensitive to augmentation, whereas cross-dataset performance varied widely. Geometry-based augmentations including affine, shift-scale-rotate, flip, and perspective produced the largest and most consistent gains, while aggressive intensity- and artefact-based transforms often degraded transfer. Moreover, pairwise combinations outperformed individual augmentations mainly when the two transformations were complementary, particularly by improving some difficult domain-shift cases from poor to acceptable performance. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing augmentation policies that improve the robustness and transferability of echocardiography segmentation models.

title: Bridging the Gap on AI-Assisted Scientific Software Development Through Transparency and Traceability
comments: 11 figures, 25 main pages (42 total pages including supplementary materials)
summary: The widespread adoption of AI-assisted development in scientific software is not a future concern -- it is a present reality. Researchers are already using large language models to write code, generate test cases, and draft documentation, yet this practice remains largely unacknowledged and unguided in formal workflows and published work. This ad hoc, ungoverned use of AI represents a systemic risk to scientific software quality, particularly in safety-relevant modeling and simulation tools subject to strict Software Quality Assurance (SQA), or even Nuclear Quality Assurance Level 1 (NQA-1) standards, for which traceability, independent verification, and documented procedures are paramount. The question facing the scientific software community is, therefore, not whether to permit AI-assisted development, but how to govern it responsibly. This paper proposes guidance for AI-assisted code development in the context of strict software quality assurance. Using TMAP8 -- an open-source tritium migration code for fusion energy -- as a demonstration platform, we propose a structured framework for AI-assisted verification and validation (V&V) case development. V&V case development represents the ideal proving ground for establishing that governance: because validation cases have known solutions, correctness is objectively measurable, errors are identifiable by design, and the artifacts are fully auditable. The proposed guidance, developed based on practical experience described herein, operates within NQA-1 requirements, preserves human accountability, and establishes the disclosure and review standards that responsible AI-assisted scientific software development demands.

title: EduSOC: Lightweight Security Operations Center Simulator for Cybersecurity Education
comments: Version 2: Renamed the software platform from LITE-SOC to EduSOC to avoid potential naming conflicts. Minor editorial revisions and updates throughout the manuscript. Updated to reflect acceptance for presentation at BSides Edmonton 2026
summary: This paper presents EduSOC, a lightweight web-based Security Operations Center (SOC) simulator designed for instructor-led cybersecurity education. SOC analysts must triage large volumes of alerts, separate genuine threats from false positives, and communicate decisions under time pressure. Recreating this environment in the classroom is difficult and often impractical for institutions without access to cyber ranges or enterprise security infrastructure. LITE-SOC was developed to provide a simpler alternative. The platform generates continuous streams of synthetic SOC events and offers separate student and instructor views with visualization tools, event annotation, and region-based chat. Instructors control the pacing of the exercise and can inject targeted incidents to guide the scenario. The goal is to give students a practical introduction to SOC workflows such as triage, prioritization, and decision-making without requiring a full operational SOC environment. The platform is intended for use in guided classroom exercises where students collaboratively investigate alerts and practice real-time triage and communication.

title: HJ-Gauss: A Monte-Carlo HJ Reachability Scheme
summary: Numerical solutions to viscous Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachable sets incur an $O(M^n)$ memory cost ($M$ grid points per $n$ state dimension) that precludes high-dimensional systems applications. We propose a Picard iterative Gaussian sampling scheme for working around this bottleneck, whereupon a Cole-Hopf-type transformation reduces the BRT's HJ PDE to a sequence of linear heat equations whose solutions are Gaussian heat-kernel expectations under the Feynman-Kac formula. The value and its spatial gradient are then recovered by Monte Carlo roll-outs over these Gaussian densities in an iterative Picard scheme. This yields a storage- and discretization-free algorithm whose memory scales as $N\cdot n$, for $N$ samples on an $n$-dimensional system. In addition, we provide an $O(N^{-1/2})$ finite-sample concentration bound, conditional linear convergence, and address numerical considerations in the practicality of our scheme. The algorithm is rigorously benchmarked first, against rocket launch and Dubins pursuit-evasion games (over 30 Monte Carlo trials). We observe a $0.02$-$0.13$ relative $L^2_{\text{rel}}$ error, significantly below the viscosity bound in every tested condition (Holm-Bonferroni-corrected, $p<10^{-50}$), with $14$-$24$ second wall-clock times per 2D slice on a single CPU. An $n=45$-dimensional, 15 multi-rocket scalability study, that is impossible with classical solvers, shows a stable Picard residual floor of $0.0002$-$0.0006$ across three speed regime. Finally, we certify the safety of murmurations of \textbf{$100,000$} European starlings (\textit{sturnus vulgaris}), modeled as 4D aerial Dubins vehicles, through parallel per-bird evaluations of shared flock-level value functions; the resulting BRT zero-levelset phase topology as predator attacks evolve reveals vacuole nucleation, cordon formation, and flock splitting, demonstrating the scalability of our approach.

title: A Unified Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Explainable Artificial Intelligence: A Case Study in Power Quality Disturbance Classification
summary: Post-hoc explainable AI (XAI) methods usually return one attribution map, even when the model represents uncertainty in its parameters. We define the \emph{explanation distribution} as the distribution of attribution maps obtained from sampled models. The uncertainty-aware relevance attribution operator (UA-RAO) summarises this distribution using the mean, dispersion, quantiles, and agreement sets. The theory separates posterior-approximation error from finite-sample error and accounts for changes across activation boundaries and for stochastic explainers. On a 15-class power-quality-disturbance benchmark, the mean occlusion explanation from a deep ensemble aligns better with known disturbance regions than the deterministic baseline, although the improvement depends on the disturbance type. Tests with controlled input distortions show that additive noise changes the explanations more than amplitude scaling or aligned temporal shifts.

title: Short-Term-to-Long-Term Memory Transfer for Knowledge Graphs under Partial Observability
summary: Reinforcement learning under partial observability requires deciding what information to retain, yet most memory-based approaches do not explicitly model short-term-to-long-term transfer of symbolic observations. We study this transfer process in a temporal knowledge-graph memory setting and cast it as a neuro-symbolic value-based decision problem: for each observed triple, the agent chooses whether to keep or drop it before long-term insertion. To handle variable-sized short-term buffers, we use a per-item Q-learning design with shared parameters and a practical temporal-difference update over matched items across consecutive steps. On the RoomKG benchmark at long-term memory capacity 128, learned transfer decisions outperform symbolic and neural baselines, including symbolic baselines with temporal annotations and history-based LSTM/Transformer baselines. Across transfer-policy ablations, a lightweight local short-term-only variant performs best, and step-level behavior shows that the policy keeps navigation- and query-relevant facts while discarding lower-value candidate facts, supporting explicit and interpretable memory decisions under memory constraints.

title: Adaptive Measurement Allocation for Learning Kernelized SVMs Under Noisy Observations
summary: Kernel methods are typically formulated under the assumption of exact, noise-free access to the Gram matrix. However, in emerging settings each kernel entry must be inferred from noisy observations, and its accuracy depends on how a limited measurement budget is allocated. Despite this, existing approaches overwhelmingly rely on uniform allocation, which equalizes estimator variance but ignores the highly non-uniform dependence of kernelized classifiers on the Gram matrix. In this work, we formulate measurement allocation for noisy kernel estimation as a task-aware optimization problem tailored to kernelized Support Vector Machines (SVMs). We derive a variance-aware allocation framework that combines classifier sensitivity with estimator uncertainty, leading to a Neyman-type allocation rule for measurement-based kernels and a Bernoulli specialization relevant to quantum kernel estimation. Building on this analysis, we develop an adaptive measurement allocation strategy that combines margin sensitivity and active set instability, concentrating measurements on the most classifier-relevant regions of the kernel matrix. Theoretical analysis reveals distinct allocation regimes governed by the heterogeneity of the induced allocation weights, identifying conditions under which adaptive or uniform strategies are preferable. Experiments on synthetic and quantum-kernel datasets demonstrate improved classifier fidelity relative to uniform allocation, while a dual coefficient stability criterion enables substantial measurement savings through early stopping. Together, these results establish adaptive measurement allocation as an effective alternative to uniform sampling for learning with noisy kernels, improving both predictive accuracy and measurement efficiency.

title: GoQuant: Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection for Multiplier-Free Power-of-Two Transformer Quantization
summary:
The deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) on edge devices is significantly constrained by memory capacity and the critical timing bottlenecks introduced by dense Multiply--Accumulate (MAC) arrays. In the ultra-low-bit regime, logarithmic Power-of-Two (PoT) quantization provides a hardware-efficient alternative by replacing general multiplications in the dominant dot-product computation with bit-shift operations. However, its non-uniform exponential lattice inherently suffers from a \textbf{Low Angular Resolution Regime}, a structural limitation that becomes particularly pronounced below 4-bit precision and can substantially degrade the representation of high-dimensional feature manifolds.
  To address this geometric limitation, we propose Geometric Orthogonal Residual Projection Quantization (GoQuant), an algorithm--hardware co-design framework for multiplier-reduced low-bit inference. By formulating quantization as a dual-basis geometric projection, GoQuant constructs a higher-resolution residual lattice while retaining a shift-and-add inner-product structure. Its analytical solver further avoids computationally intensive gradient-based or iterative search procedures. The data-free Geometric-Only (GEO) mode quantizes LLaMA-2-7B in only 0.47 minutes, while the Activation-Refined (REF) mode completes full-model quantization in approximately \textbf{4.4 minutes}.

title: Beyond Epsilon: A Principled QIF Framework for Local Differential Privacy
summary: Local Differential Privacy (LDP) has become the de facto standard for privacy-preserving data collection in large-scale systems, in particular for the purpose of estimating frequencies. However, the current research landscape lacks a systematic and principled way to compare LDP protocols. The parameter $\varepsilon$ of LDP is considered the measure of privacy, but it only bounds worst-case distinguishability. Other comparisons rely on utility-driven analyses, where mechanisms are ranked based on their ability to preserve data utility for a given privacy budget $\varepsilon$. Both such kinds of comparisons fail to account for the strength of protocols against diverse attacker models. In this paper, we propose a framework for analyzing LDP frequency estimation protocols through the lens of Quantitative Information Flow (QIF). By modeling LDP mechanisms as probabilistic channels, we leverage the concept of refinement (Blackwell ordering) to establish more principled classifications. This approach allows us to determine when one protocol is intrinsically superior to another for all possible adversaries, and to discuss the implications for utility. In particular, our analysis uncovers cases where protocols previously deemed "optimal" are, in fact, incomparable with, or strictly dominated by, other protocols. We provide a formal QIF-based treatment of seven state-of-the-art protocols, including Generalized Randomized Response (GRR), local hashing variants (BLH, OLH), unary encoding schemes (SUE, OUE), and Thresholding with Histogram Encoding (THE). This perspective bridges the gap between the LDP and formal methods communities and enables principled, adversary-aware reasoning about locally private systems.

AI.title_translation: 超越 Epsilon：用于本地差分隐私的规范 QIF 框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于定量信息流（QIF）和 Blackwell 排序的 LDP 分析框架，揭示了先前被视为“最优”的 LDP 协议在多样化攻击者模型下可能被严格支配或不可比。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LDP 协议比较缺乏系统性和规范性。传统的隐私参数 $\varepsilon$ 仅能界定最坏情况下的可区分性，而基于效用的分析则忽略了协议在面对不同对手模型时的防御强度，因此亟需一种能全面考虑攻击者模型的原则性比较框架。
AI.method: 提出了一个基于定量信息流（QIF）的分析框架，将 LDP 机制建模为概率信道，并利用精炼（Blackwell 排序）概念来建立分类标准，从而确定协议对所有可能对手的内在优劣关系。论文对 GRR、BLH、OLH、SUE、OUE 和 THE 等七种主流 LDP 协议进行了形式化的 QIF 分析。
AI.result: 该分析框架揭示了此前被认为“最优”的某些 LDP 协议在考虑全面攻击者模型时，实际上与其他协议不可比，或者被其他协议严格支配（严格劣于）；同时阐明了这些比较对数据效用的具体影响。
AI.conclusion: 该研究弥合了本地差分隐私（LDP）与形式化方法（QIF）两个领域之间的鸿沟，实现了对本地隐私系统在面对多样化攻击者时的规范化、面向对手的理性推理与评估。
AI.translation: 本地差分隐私（LDP）已成为大规模系统中保护隐私的数据收集（特别是频率估计）的事实标准。然而，当前的研究缺乏一种系统化且规范的方式来比较不同的 LDP 协议。LDP 的参数 $\varepsilon$ 被视为隐私的度量，但它仅界定了最坏情况下的可区分性。其他比较依赖于效用驱动的分析，即在给定的隐私预算 $\varepsilon$ 下，根据机制保留数据效用的能力对其进行排名。这两种比较方式都未能考虑到协议针对不同攻击者模型的防御强度。在本文中，我们提出了一个从定量信息流（QIF）视角分析 LDP 频率估计协议的框架。通过将 LDP 机制建模为概率信道，我们利用精炼（Blackwell 排序）的概念建立了更加规范的分类。这种方法使我们能够确定何时某种协议对所有可能的对手而言本质上优于另一种协议，并讨论其对效用的影响。特别是，我们的分析揭示了一些先前被认为“最优”的协议实际上与其他协议不可比，或被其他协议严格支配的情况。我们对包括通用随机化响应（GRR）、局部哈希变体（BLH、OLH）、一元编码方案（SUE、OUE）以及直方图编码阈值化（THE）在内的七种最新协议进行了形式化的 QIF 处理。这一视角弥合了 LDP 与形式化方法社区之间的鸿沟，并实现了对本地隐私系统面向攻击者的规范化推理。
AI.summary: 针对现有本地差分隐私（LDP）评估仅依赖参数 $\varepsilon$ 或单一效用指标而忽略多样化攻击者模型的缺陷，本文提出了一种基于定量信息流（QIF）和 Blackwell 排序的规范分析框架。该框架将 LDP 协议建模为概率信道，对七种经典频率估计协议进行了形式化分析，揭示了部分既有“最优”协议的实际局限性，为 LDP 机制的评估提供了更具防御感知性的形式化视角。
AI.keywords: 本地差分隐私, 定量信息流, 频率估计, Blackwell排序, 隐私保护
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：引入形式化方法中的定量信息流（QIF）和 Blackwell 排序（精炼）理论，打破了传统仅依赖隐私预算 $\varepsilon$ 和单一效用指标的局限，提出了超越最坏情况可区分性的全新评估维度。
2. 重要性：重新审视并纠正了此前对 LDP 协议“最优性”的认识，揭示了某些被广泛认可的“最优”协议在特定对手模型下实际被严格支配或不可比，对未来隐私机制的选择与设计具有重要指导意义。
3. 局限性：分析主要集中于频率估计任务和七种特定协议，对于更为复杂的非频率估计场景以及高维动态数据的适用性仍需进一步探索。

title: TrajAudit: Automated Failure Diagnosis for Agentic Coding Systems
summary:
Agentic systems have been widely studied to automate coding tasks such as bug fixing and feature implementation. As these systems increasingly operate on complex codebases, understanding where and why they fail becomes essential for iterative refinement and operational reliability. Existing automated failure diagnosis approaches leverage \textit{task execution trajectories}, yet they struggle with trajectories produced by repository-level coding agents due to two key properties. First, these trajectories are often long, spanning many execution steps, making it difficult for LLMs to track the causal chain of failure over the execution history. Second, these trajectories are laden with noise, containing substantial low-signal observations such as redundant program structures and verbose code context, which can interfere with LLM reasoning.
  To address these challenges, we propose \textit{TrajAudit}, an automated failure diagnosis framework specifically for trajectories produced by repository-level coding agents. TrajAudit employs an investigator agent supported by two modules: one reduces failure-irrelevant noisy context through semantic saliency folding, and the other derives preliminary diagnostic guidance from test failure reports as prior knowledge to help LLMs focus on likely failure regions. The investigator agent can further invoke tools to inspect folded content on demand, enabling a focused investigation without losing access to the full trajectory context. We also introduce \textit{RootSE}, a benchmark of 102 real-world instances from repository-level coding tasks, each annotated with the earliest decisive error step and a justification. Experiments on RootSE show that TrajAudit outperforms the strongest baselines by 10.8\% and 21.6\% in exact failure localization accuracy in the with- and without-reference settings, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness.

AI.title_translation: TrajAudit：智能体代码构建系统的自动化故障诊断
AI.tldr: TrajAudit是一种专为仓库级代码智能体设计的故障诊断框架，通过语义折叠与测试报告引导，大幅提升故障定位准确率。
AI.motivation: 代码智能体在处理仓库级任务时生成的执行轨迹极其冗长且充满噪声（如冗余的程序结构和代码上下文），导致大语言模型（LLM）难以追踪故障因果链并干扰其推理逻辑，使得现有的自动化故障诊断方法难以有效应用。
AI.method: 提出TrajAudit诊断框架，包含一个调查员智能体和两个核心模块：1）语义显著性折叠模块，用于过滤不相关的冗余噪声；2）先验诊断引导模块，利用测试失败报告帮助LLM聚焦潜在故障区域。智能体可按需调用工具解折叠并检索具体细节。此外，本文还构建了包含102个真实场景标注实例的诊断基准 RootSE。
AI.result: 在 RootSE 基准上的实验结果显示，TrajAudit 在有参考和无参考设置下的精确故障定位准确率分别超越了最强基线方法 10.8% 和 21.6%。
AI.conclusion: TrajAudit能够有效解决仓库级代码智能体轨迹长、噪声多的问题，显著提升故障定位准确率，为智能体系统的迭代优化与可靠性保障提供了强有力的支持。
AI.translation: 智能体系统已得到广泛研究，用于自动执行诸如缺陷修复和功能实现等编码任务。随着这些系统越来越多地在大规模复杂代码库上运行，理解它们何时以及为何失败对于迭代改进和运行可靠性至关重要。现有的自动故障诊断方法利用了任务执行轨迹，但由于两个关键特性，它们难以处理仓库级代码智能体生成的轨迹。首先，这些轨迹通常很长，跨越许多执行步骤，使得大语言模型（LLM）难以在整个执行历史中追踪故障的因果链。其次，这些轨迹充满了噪声，包含大量低信号的观察结果（如冗余的程序结构和冗长的代码上下文），这会干扰LLM的推理。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 TrajAudit，这是一个专门针对仓库级代码智能体生成的轨迹的自动故障诊断框架。TrajAudit 使用了一个由两个模块支持的调查员智能体：一个模块通过语义显著性折叠减少与故障无关的噪声上下文，另一个模块从测试失败报告中提取初步诊断指导作为先验知识，以帮助 LLM 聚焦于可能的故障区域。调查员智能体还可以根据需要调用工具来检查折叠内容，从而在不丢失对完整轨迹上下文访问权限的前提下实现有针对性的调查。我们还推出了 RootSE，这是一个由 102 个来自仓库级编码任务的真实世界实例组成的基准数据集，每个实例都标注了最早的决定性错误步骤和理由。在 RootSE 上的实验表明，TrajAudit 在有参考和无参考设置下的精确故障定位准确率分别比最强基线高出 10.8% 和 21.6%，证明了其有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了针对仓库级代码智能体系统执行轨迹的自动化故障诊断框架 TrajAudit。通过语义显著性折叠和基于测试报告的先验知识引导，TrajAudit 能大幅减少信息噪声并精确定位故障，结合新构建的 RootSE 评测基准，验证了其卓越的诊断准确率。
AI.keywords: 代码智能体, 故障诊断, 执行轨迹, 语义折叠, RootSE基准
AI.comments: 该研究针对智能体在仓库级复杂代码库中运行轨迹过长、噪声过高的核心痛点，创新性地结合了语义显著性折叠技术与按需工具检查机制，在降低大模型上下文压力的同时保留了完整上下文检索能力。此外，提出的 RootSE 基准数据集填补了代码智能体故障定位评测领域的空白，具有较高的实用与科研价值。

title: Can Vision-Language-Action Models Learn from Real-World Data Continually without Forgetting?
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a promising foundation for general-purpose robotics, yet their real-world deployment demands the ability to continually acquire new skills without forgetting prior ones. While recent studies have explored continual learning for VLA models in simulated settings, the challenge remains largely unexamined under realistic physical conditions. To bridge this gap, we construct a real-world continual learning benchmark comprising ten diverse sequential manipulation tasks across both single-arm and bimanual configurations. Through extensive experiments on this benchmark, we find that naive sequential fine-tuning leads to severe catastrophic forgetting, whereas a well-configured experience replay (ER) approach can effectively mitigate forgetting and outperform joint multi-task training under equivalent computational budgets. Notably, by synthesizing our empirical findings, we successfully achieve stable continual learning across the full 10-task heterogeneous stream, retaining previously acquired capabilities while adapting to diverse new skills in real-world deployment. This work presents an empirical study grounded in real-world continual VLA learning and offers actionable insights for deploying robust, long-lived robotic policies.

AI.title_translation: 视觉-语言-动作模型能否在真实世界数据中持续学习而不发生遗忘？
AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个真实世界VLA模型持续学习基准（含10个单/双臂任务），证明经验重放能有效解决灾难性遗忘且性能超越联合训练。
AI.motivation: VLA模型是通用机器人的重要基础，但真实世界部署需要模型能够持续学习新技能且不遗忘旧技能。目前针对VLA模型持续学习的研究多局限于仿真环境，缺乏真实物理条件下的探索。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含10个异构顺序操作任务（涵盖单臂和双臂配置）的真实世界持续学习基准，并在此基准上评估了朴素顺序微调与经验重放（Experience Replay, ER）方法的表现。
AI.result: 朴素顺序微调会导致严重的灾难性遗忘；而合理配置的经验重放（ER）方法能有效缓解遗忘，并在相同计算预算下表现优于联合多任务训练，成功在10个真实异构任务流上实现了稳定的持续学习。
AI.conclusion: 本研究对真实世界中VLA模型的持续学习进行了深入的实证探索，为部署鲁棒、可持续进化的真实机器人策略提供了切实可行的指导见解。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为通用机器人技术提供了广阔的前景，然而其在真实世界的部署要求模型具备持续获取新技能而不遗忘旧技能的能力。虽然最近的研究在仿真环境中探索了VLA模型的持续学习，但在现实物理条件下的挑战很大程度上仍未得到检验。为了弥补这一空白，我们构建了一个包含单臂和双臂配置下十个不同顺序操作任务的真实世界持续学习基准。通过在该基准上的广泛实验，我们发现朴素的顺序微调会导致严重的灾难性遗忘，而配置得当的经验重放（ER）方法可以有效缓解遗忘，并在同等计算预算下超越联合多任务训练。值得注意的是，通过总结我们的实证发现，我们成功在包含10个异构任务的完整数据流中实现了稳定的持续学习，在适应真实部署中各种新技能的同时保留了先前获得的能力。这项工作提供了一项基于真实世界持续VLA学习的实证研究，并为部署鲁棒、长寿命的机器人策略提供了可操作的见解。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实物理世界中的持续学习问题。针对仿真与真实部署之间的空白，作者创建了涵盖10个单双臂操作任务的真实世界基准。研究表明，直接进行顺序微调会导致严重遗忘，而采用经验重放策略不仅能有效防止遗忘，还在相同计算资源下超越了多任务联合训练，实现了真实场景中长流程异构任务的稳定技能累积。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 持续学习, 灾难性遗忘, 经验重放, 真实世界机器人操作
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于打破了过去VLA模型持续学习仅在仿真环境中评估的局限，首次构建了涵盖单臂与双臂10个异构任务的真实物理世界基准。重要性在于证明了经验重放（ER）在真实机器人部署中缓解灾难性遗忘的有效性，且效率优于多任务联合训练，为实现长寿命机器人策略提供了重要实证支持。局限性在于摘要中未详细说明经验重放的数据采样策略及缓冲区大小对性能的具体影响，需结合正文进一步分析。

title: Feedforward 3D Editing Learns from Semantic-Part Transformation
summary: 3D editing is a fundamental capability for scalable 3D content creation. While image editing has rapidly evolved toward large-scale feedforward generative paradigms, 3D AI generation remains dominated by training-free editing pipelines. A central challenge of feedforward 3D editing lies in the lack of high-quality paired supervision. Editable 3D assets require simultaneous preservation of geometry, multi-view consistency, structural coherence, and localized edit controllability. Existing 3D editing datasets often rely on independently generated assets, image-mediated reconstruction or narrow edit taxonomies, leading to inaccurate localization, weak preservation, blurred edit boundaries, and limited semantic consistency. In this work, we introduce a new perspective: scalable feedforward 3D editing should be learned from semantic-part transformations. Based on this insight, we propose Pxform, a high-quality 3D editing dataset with over 100K consistent before/after editing pairs across seven edit types. Instead of treating objects as unstructured shapes, our pipeline grounds edits directly in semantic 3D parts. Built upon Pxform, we further propose PartFlow, a feedforward 3D editing network that injects source-aware latent control into pretrained 3D generative priors. PartFlow introduces mask-aware velocity preservation and render-space consistency supervision to jointly improve edit fidelity and source preservation, while requiring no 3D edit mask during inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that high-quality semantic-part supervision substantially improves scalable 3D editing, enabling PartFlow to achieve state-of-the-art performance on both geometric and appearance editing benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 前馈3D编辑从语义部件变换中学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了包含超10万对数据的高质量3D编辑数据集Pxform及前馈网络PartFlow，通过语义部件变换实现了无需推理掩码的高保真3D几何与外观编辑。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D编辑面临的核心挑战是缺乏高质量的成对监督数据。现有的3D编辑数据集多依赖独立生成的资产、图像中介重建或狭隘的编辑分类，导致编辑定位不准、源特征保持能力弱、编辑边界模糊以及语义一致性差。
AI.method: 1. 提出了Pxform数据集：构建了首个包含超10万对高一致性前后编辑对的大规模3D编辑数据集，覆盖7种编辑类型，将编辑直接锚定在语义3D部件上；\n2. 提出了PartFlow前馈编辑网络：将源感知潜在控制注入预训练3D生成先验中，结合掩码感知速度保持（mask-aware velocity preservation）与渲染空间一致性监督，在推理阶段无需任何3D编辑掩码即可进行精准编辑。
AI.result: PartFlow在几何编辑和外观编辑基准测试中均取得了当前最先进（SOTA）的性能，成功实现了高编辑保真度与强源特征保持。
AI.conclusion: 高质量的语义部件监督能够大幅提升可扩展的3D编辑质量，证实了基于语义部件变换学习3D编辑的有效性，为大规模前馈3D生成与编辑开辟了新途径。
AI.translation: 3D编辑是实现可扩展3D内容创作的一项基本能力。虽然图像编辑已迅速向大规模前馈生成范式演进，但3D AI生成仍由免训练编辑管线主导。前馈3D编辑的核心挑战在于缺乏高质量的成对监督。可编辑的3D资产需要同时保持几何形状、多视角一致性、结构连贯性以及局部编辑可控性。现有的3D编辑数据集通常依赖于独立生成的资产、图像中介重建或狭隘的编辑分类，导致定位不准确、保持能力弱、编辑边界模糊和语义一致性有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个新视角：可扩展的前馈3D编辑应该从语义部件变换中学习。基于这一洞察，我们提出了Pxform，这是一个高质量的3D编辑数据集，在七种编辑类型中拥有超过10万个一致的编辑前后对。我们的管线不是将对象视为无结构的形状，而是将编辑直接锚定在语义3D部件中。基于Pxform，我们进一步提出了PartFlow，这是一个前馈3D编辑网络，将源感知潜在控制注入到预训练的3D生成先验中。PartFlow引入了掩码感知速度保持和渲染空间一致性监督，在推理期间不需要3D编辑掩码的情况下，共同提高编辑保真度和源保持度。广泛的实验表明，高质量的语义部件监督大幅提升了可扩展的3D编辑，使PartFlow在几何和外观编辑基准上均取得了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 针对前馈3D编辑缺乏高质量成对数据及控制不精准的问题，本文提出了从语义部件变换中学习3D编辑的新视角。作者创建了包含超10万对一致编辑数据的Pxform数据集，并基于此开发了前馈3D编辑网络PartFlow。PartFlow将源感知控制与渲染空间一致性监督引入预训练生成先验，无需推理阶段的3D掩码即可实现高质量的几何与外观编辑，达到了SOTA水平。
AI.keywords: 3D编辑, 前馈生成, 语义部件变换, Pxform数据集, PartFlow
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于打破了将3D资产视为无结构形状的传统思路，提出将3D编辑建立在语义部件变换的基础之上。构建的大规模成对数据集Pxform（10万+编辑对）有效填补了前馈3D编辑领域高质量成对监督数据的空白。设计的PartFlow模型在推理时无需显式3D编辑掩码，大幅提升了易用性与前馈生成效率。潜在限制在于数据集的生成对部件分割精度有一定依赖，且对于极度复杂的非刚性结构形变可能仍受限于底层3D生成先验的能力上限。

title: Unified sparse framework for large-scale simulations using the material point method
summary: The material point method (MPM) is a hybrid particle-grid method widely used for large deformation problems with history-dependent behavior, including geophysical mass flows. Standard MPM often relies on a dense background grid, which can be highly inefficient when material occupies a small fraction of the computational domain. Such sparsity is common in many large-scale geophysical mass flow problems. Here, we introduce a unified sparse background-grid framework for large-scale MPM simulation. The framework treats sparse grid construction as a general active-node indexing problem. We develop two architecture-specific implementations to realize the same sparse framework: a scan-based strategy for CPUs and a hash-based strategy for GPUs. Through benchmark problems and a large-scale landslide simulation, we show that the framework provides identical results as standard dense MPM while reducing computational time and memory usage by one to two orders of magnitude in strongly sparse cases.

AI.title_translation: 基于物质点法的大规模模拟统一稀疏框架
AI.tldr: 提出了针对物质点法的统一稀疏背景网格框架，并通过CPU和GPU的针对性实现，将大规模稀疏模拟的时间和内存开销降低了1-2个数量级。
AI.motivation: 标准物质点法（MPM）依赖于密集背景网格，当物质仅占计算域的一小部分时（在大规模地球物理质量流中很常见），会导致严重的计算和内存资源浪费。
AI.method: 将稀疏网格构建抽象为通用的活动节点索引问题，提出了统一的稀疏背景网格框架，并针对不同硬件架构设计了两种实现策略：CPU上采用基于扫描（scan-based）的策略，GPU上采用基于哈希（hash-based）的策略。
AI.result: 基准测试和大规模滑坡模拟表明，该框架能产生与标准密集MPM完全一致的结果，且在强稀疏情况下将计算时间和内存使用量降低了一到两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该统一稀疏框架在保证与传统密集MPM计算精度一致的前提下，显著提高了大规模稀疏模拟的计算与内存效率，为大规模地球物理质量流模拟提供了高效解决方案。
AI.translation: 物质点法（MPM）是一种混合粒子-网格方法，广泛应用于具有历史依赖特性的极大变形问题（包括地球物理质量流）。标准的MPM通常依赖于密集的背景网格，当材料仅占据计算域的一小部分时，这种方式效率极低。这种稀疏性在大规模地球物理质量流问题中非常普遍。在此，我们提出了一种用于大规模MPM模拟的统一稀疏背景网格框架。该框架将稀疏网格构建视为一个通用的活动节点索引问题。我们针对不同的架构开发了两种具体实现以达成相同的稀疏框架：针对CPU的基于扫描（scan-based）策略和针对GPU的基于哈希（hash-based）策略。通过基准测试问题和大规模滑坡模拟，我们证明了该框架能够提供与标准密集MPM完全一致的结果，同时在强稀疏情况下将计算时间和内存占用降低一到两个数量级。
AI.summary: 本文针对物质点法（MPM）在大规模稀疏场景下计算效率低的问题，提出了统一的稀疏背景网格框架。该框架将稀疏网格构建抽象为活动节点索引问题，并针对CPU与GPU分别实现了基于扫描和基于哈希的算法。试验表明该框架在保证精度的同时大幅降低了计算时间和内存开销。
AI.keywords: 物质点法, 稀疏背景网格, 大规模模拟, 地球物理质量流, GPU加速
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将稀疏背景网格的构建抽象为统一的活动节点索引问题，并针对CPU（基于扫描）和GPU（基于哈希）硬件架构分别给出了高效实现。其重要性在于大幅突破了传统物质点法在超大规模地球物理灾害（如滑坡、泥石流）模拟中的内存和计算瓶颈。局限性在于摘要未讨论材料填充率较高（非稀疏）场景下的额外索引开销。

title: PatchWorld: Gradient-Free Optimization of Executable World Models for Agent Environments
summary: World models for interactive text agents must typically be learned from observation-action trajectories alone. Specifically, the environment returns text observations after each action, but does not expose a ground-truth latent state nor an inspectable transition model.A research gap remains in how to induce executable code as a world model in this black-box setting for prediction and agent decision making. We introduce PatchWorld, a gradient-free framework that turns offline trajectories into executable Python world models through counterexample-guided code repair.Instead of predicting the next observation with a black-box model, PatchWorld induces symbolic belief-state programs whose action updates can be inspected, replayed, and locally patched. Across seven AgentGym environments, PatchWorld-Simple achieves the highest code-based decision-making score among evaluated methods (76.4% macro success in live one-step lookahead), matching or exceeding LLM-based lookahead while invoking no LLM calls inside the world-model prediction module itself. We further find that a human-specified residual-memory bias improves surface observation fidelity but weakens agent decision-making utility. This reveals a tradeoff in executable world models, since improving observation fidelity can come at the expense of action-discriminative dynamics, and vice versa. Code is available at https://github.com/HKBU-KnowComp/PatchWorld.

AI.title_translation: PatchWorld：面向智能体环境的可执行世界模型的无梯度优化
AI.tldr: PatchWorld 采用反例引导的代码修复技术，将离线轨迹转化为可执行 Python 代码世界模型，在零 LLM 预测调用的情况下实现了高精度的智能体决策。
AI.motivation: 交互式文本智能体环境仅提供文本观察且不暴露内部潜状态或迁移模型。如何在黑盒设置下直接将离线轨迹诱导为可执行代码形式的世界模型用于预测和决策，目前仍存在研究空白。
AI.method: 提出 PatchWorld 框架，利用反例引导的代码修复（counterexample-guided code repair）将离线轨迹转化为可执行的 Python 世界模型，诱导生成可审查、可重放和局部修复的符号化信念状态程序（symbolic belief-state programs）。
AI.result: 在 7 个 AgentGym 环境中，PatchWorld-Simple 取得了最高的基于代码的决策分数（单步前瞻宏观成功率 76.4%），在预测模块内部零 LLM 调用的情况下达到或超越了基于 LLM 的前瞻；同时发现人类指定的残差记忆偏置虽能提高观察忠实度，但会削弱决策效用。
AI.conclusion: 可执行世界模型中存在明确的权衡机制：提高表面观察忠实度可能会以牺牲动作区分性动力学（决策效用）为代价，反之亦然。
AI.translation: 交互式文本智能体的世界模型通常必须仅从“观察-动作”轨迹中学习。具体而言，环境在每个动作后返回文本观察，但不暴露真实潜状态或可审查的迁移模型。在黑盒设置下，如何诱导可执行代码作为世界模型用于预测和智能体决策，仍然存在研究空白。我们提出了 PatchWorld，这是一个无梯度框架，通过反例引导的代码修复将离线轨迹转换为可执行的 Python 世界模型。PatchWorld 不使用黑盒模型预测下一个观察，而是诱导生成符号化信念状态程序，其动作更新可以被审查、重放和局部修复。在七个 AgentGym 环境中，PatchWorld-Simple 在评估方法中取得了最高的基于代码的决策分数（实时单步前瞻中的宏观成功率为 76.4%），在世界模型预测模块本身不调用 LLM 的情况下，达到或超过了基于 LLM 的前瞻。我们还发现，人类指定的残差记忆偏置提高了表面观察忠实度，但削弱了智能体的决策效用。这揭示了可执行世界模型中的一种权衡，即提高观察忠实度可能会以牺牲动作区分性动力学为代价，反之亦然。代码见 https://github.com/HKBU-KnowComp/PatchWorld。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 PatchWorld，一种通过反例引导代码修复来从离线轨迹诱导 Python 可执行世界模型的无梯度框架。该方法生成可审查的符号程序，无需在预测过程中调用 LLM 即可实现高性能单步前瞻决策，并揭示了观察忠实度与决策效用之间的权衡关系。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 可执行代码, 无梯度优化, 符号信念状态, 文本智能体
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将可解释的代码生成与反例引导的无梯度优化结合，用于构建可执行的符号化世界模型，大幅降低了推理时对 LLM 的调用开销。其重要性在于探索了确定性代码作为代理环境世界模型的可行性，并首次明确揭示了观察忠实度与动作区分效用之间的权衡关系。局限性可能在于纯 Python 程序在处理极度复杂或开放域的自然语言状态时可能面临表达力受限的问题。

title: Quantum Simultaneous Information and Power Transfer: Capacity-Power Trade-offs in Discrete and Continuous Channels
summary: This paper introduces a new framework for quantum simultaneous information and power transfer (QSIPT), enabling the joint use of quantum states for classical information and energy transfer in quantum communication systems. We propose a model in which quantum states simultaneously transmit classical information through a quantum channel and transfer energy to an energy harvesting (EH) receiver. The trade-off between communication rate and harvested energy is characterized by the capacity-power function, defined for both discrete-variable (DV) and continuous-variable (CV) quantum channels. For DV channels, we derive properties of the capacity-power function, providing analytical upper and lower bounds for the amplitude damping channel and an exact closed-form characterization for the quantum erasure channel. For CV channels, we extend the framework by introducing a generalized beam-splitter (BS) receiver with adjustable transmissivity, jointly optimized with a transmitter mean-photon-number budget, splitting the channel output between the information decoder and the EH receiver. We analyze the capacity-power and achievable-rate-power trade-off under various Gaussian encoding schemes, including coherent, squeezed, and thermal states, for both lossy bosonic and additive Gaussian noise channels. Closed-form expressions are derived for coherent-state encoding under the joint photon-number-budget and adjustable-transmissivity formulation; squeezed-state inputs are evaluated numerically. Our results show that, within the considered displaced Gaussian encoding class, coherent states achieve the best capacity-power trade-off, squeezed states do not outperform coherent-state encoding under the phase-insensitive channel and passive receiver architecture, and thermal states enable energy transfer without supporting reliable communication.

AI.title_translation: 量子同时信息与功率传输：离散与连续信道中的容量-功率折衷
AI.tldr: 本文建立了量子同时信息与功率传输（QSIPT）理论框架，给出了离散和连续变量量子信道中信息速率与采集能量之间的容量-功率权衡边界与闭式解。
AI.motivation: 旨在建立量子同时信息与功率传输（QSIPT）的新理论框架，以探究在量子通信系统中使用量子态同时进行经典信息传输与能量收集的可行性及物理极限。
AI.method: 提出了QSIPT理论模型，定义了DV和CV量子信道的容量-功率函数。对DV信道（振幅衰减信道、量子擦除信道）推导边界与闭式解；对CV信道引入透射率可调的分束器接收机架构，结合发射机光子数预算，针对相干态、压缩态及热态等高斯编码方案进行解析推导和数值评估。
AI.result: 为量子擦除信道和相干态CV信道推导了容量-功率函数的闭式表达式。结果表明，在所考虑的位移高斯编码中，相干态实现了最优的容量-功率折衷；在相位不敏感信道和被动接收机下压缩态并不优于相干态；热态仅能传输能量而无法支持可靠通信。
AI.conclusion: QSIPT框架成功表征了量子通信系统中经典信息传输与能量收集之间的物理极限，且在位移高斯编码策略中，相干态被证明具备最佳的容量-功率权衡性能。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一种全新的量子同时信息与功率传输（QSIPT）框架，实现了在量子通信系统中联合利用量子态进行经典信息和能量传输。我们提出了一个模型，在该模型中量子态通过量子信道同时传输经典信息并向能量收集（EH）接收机传输能量。通信速率与采集能量之间的权衡由容量-功率函数表征，该函数定义于离散变量（DV）和连续变量（CV）量子信道。对于DV信道，我们推导了容量-功率函数的性质，为振幅衰减信道提供了解析上下界，并为量子擦除信道给出了精确的闭式刻画。对于CV信道，我们通过引入具有可调透射率的通用分束器（BS）接收机来扩展该框架，并与发射机平均光子数预算联合优化，将信道输出划分为信息解码器和EH接收机两部分。我们分析了在各种高斯编码方案（包括相干态、压缩态和热态）下，针对损耗玻色信道和加性高斯噪声信道的容量-功率和可达速率-功率权衡。在联合光子数预算和可调透射率公式下，推导了相干态编码的闭式表达式；对压缩态输入进行了数值评估。我们的结果表明，在所考虑的位移高斯编码类中，相干态实现了最佳的容量-功率权衡，在相位不敏感信道和被动接收机架构下压缩态并不优于相干态编码，而热态能够实现能量传输但无法支持可靠通信。
AI.summary: 本文提出了量子同时信息与功率传输（QSIPT）框架，深入研究了离散变量（DV）与连续变量（CV）量子信道中的容量-功率折衷关系，并针对不同信道模型与高斯量子态给出了相应的性能极限、闭式解及数值评估。
AI.keywords: 量子同时信息与功率传输, 容量-功率权衡, 离散变量量子信道, 连续变量量子信道, 高斯编码
AI.comments: 该研究将经典的无线携能通信（SWIPT）概念成功拓展至量子领域（QSIPT），填补了量子通信中信息与能量联合传输理论的空白。论文全面覆盖了离散变量和连续变量两种量子信道体系，理论推导严谨，给出了多种典型信道与高斯编码下的边界与闭式解，对未来量子网络与低功耗量子节点的联合设计具有重要指导价值。

title: Detect Before You Leap: Mirage Detection in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can produce confident visual answers even when the required visual evidence is missing, blank, or unrelated to the question. This failure mode, recently described as mirage (Asadi et al., 2026), is especially concerning in medical and document VQA, where visually ungrounded answers may be mistaken for image-based evidence. We study pre-release mirage detection: given an image-question pair, determine whether a VLM's answer should be released or the system should abstain before the answer reaches the user. We propose Text-Conditioned Layer-wise Internal Alignment (TC-LIA), a model-agnostic method that probes patch-token representations across the layers of a CLIP ViT-H/14 vision encoder. The key idea is to project layer-wise image patch tokens into the final CLIP embedding space and measure their similarity with the question embedding, tracking whether question-relevant visual evidence emerges across vision layers. TC-LIA summarizes this trajectory using final image-text cosine similarity, late-layer top-k patch-text alignment, early-to-late gain, and layer-wise slope. These features are combined with pixel-statistic-based blank/noise detection, zero-shot domain routing, and structured VLM self-assessment in an ensemble classifier. We evaluate on 19,004 samples spanning ten VQA domains, including medical imaging, document understanding, scene text, reasoning, and video understanding, with four input conditions: RELATED, IN-DOMAIN UNRELATED, OUT-OF-DOMAIN UNRELATED, and BLANK/NOISE. Across fourteen VLMs, base prompt mirage rates range from 57.3-75.0%. TC-LIA alone reduces the mirage rate to 7.5% at 83.5% accuracy; ensemble fusion further improves performance to 84.5-88.4% accuracy with 5.7-7.2% mirage rates. The best result, obtained with Qwen2.5-VL-72B, achieves 88.4% accuracy and a 6.4% mirage rate.

AI.title_translation: 纵身跃入前先检测：视觉语言模型中的幻象检测
AI.tldr: 提出了TC-LIA及集成分类方法，在视觉语言模型回答发布前检测并阻止缺乏视觉证据的“幻象”回答，将幻象率从最高75%降至7.2%以下。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在视觉证据缺失、空白或无关时仍会给出自信但缺乏依据的回答（即“幻象/mirage”现象），这在医疗和文档问答等关键领域风险极高。因此，需要在答案发布给用户之前进行预检测，决定是释放回答还是系统弃权。
AI.method: 提出了文本条件的层级内部对齐（TC-LIA）方法。该方法探查CLIP ViT-H/14视觉编码器各层图像块Token投影到最终嵌入空间后与问题文本的相似度轨迹（关注余弦相似度、深层top-k对齐、浅层到深层增益及斜率）。随后将这些特征与像素统计检测（空白/噪声）、零样本领域路由以及结构化VLM自我评估进行集成融合分类。
AI.result: 在涵盖10个领域、19,004个样本及14种VLM的测试中，原始模型的幻象高达57.3-75.0%。单用TC-LIA即可在83.5%准确率下将幻象率降至7.5%；集成模型进一步提升准确率至84.5-88.4%，幻象率降至5.7-7.2%。其中基于Qwen2.5-VL-72B实现了最佳效果（88.4%准确率，6.4%幻象率）。
AI.conclusion: 在VLM将回答输出给用户前进行前置幻象检测与拒答是极其有效的，TC-LIA及集成分类器能够极大地降低无依据视觉回答的发生率，显著提升系统安全性与可靠性。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）即使在缺少所需视觉证据、图像空白或与问题无关的情况下，也可能给出自信的视觉回答。这种失效模式最近被称为“幻象”（mirage, Asadi et al., 2026），在医疗和文档问答（VQA）中尤为令人担忧，因为无视觉依据的回答可能会被误认为是基于图像的证据。我们研究了发布前的幻象检测：给定图像-问题对，在答案到达用户之前确定是应当发布VLM的回答还是系统放弃回答。我们提出了文本条件的层级内部对齐（TC-LIA），这是一种与模型无关的方法，用于探查CLIP ViT-H/14视觉编码器各层的图像块token表示。其核心思想是将各层图像块token投影到最终的CLIP嵌入空间中，并测量它们与问题嵌入的相似度，跟踪是否在各个视觉层中涌现出与问题相关的视觉证据。TC-LIA利用最终图像-文本余弦相似度、深层top-k图像块-文本对齐度、浅层到深层的增益以及层级斜率来概括这一轨迹。这些特征与基于像素统计的空白/噪声检测、零样本领域路由和结构化VLM自我评估结合在集成分类器中。我们在涵盖十个VQA领域（包括医疗成像、文档理解、场景文本、推理和视频理解）的19,004个样本上进行了评估，包含四种输入条件：相关、域内无关、域外无关和空白/噪声。在十四种VLM中，基础提示的幻象率范围为57.3-75.0%。仅TC-LIA就能在83.5%的准确率下将幻象率降低到7.5%；集成融合进一步将性能提升至84.5-88.4%的准确率，幻象率为5.7-7.2%。基于Qwen2.5-VL-72B获得的最佳结果实现了88.4%的准确率和6.4%的幻象率。
AI.summary: 本文针对视觉语言模型在缺少视觉依据时盲目自信回答的“幻象”（Mirage）问题，提出了预发布检测方法TC-LIA。该方法通过探查视觉编码器各层与问题文本的对齐轨迹，并结合像素检测、领域路由与VLM自我评估构建集成分类器。实验表明，该方法能大幅降低VLM的幻象率，为安全可靠的VQA部署提供了关键保障。
AI.keywords: Vision-Language Models, Mirage Detection, Layer-wise Alignment, Visual Question Answering, Model Safety
AI.comments: 本文创新性地关注了视觉语言模型在生成答案之前的“预发布”拒答机制（Pre-release detection），提出了基于视觉编码器内部层级特征与文本对齐轨迹的TC-LIA方法。研究实验覆盖了14种VLM及10个多模态领域，展现了极强的通用性和实际应用价值。潜在局限性在于集成检测流程（像素统计、内部对齐探针、自我评估等）可能会带来额外的计算开销。

title: RadioMaster: Multi-Agent System for Autonomous Radio Signal Generation
summary: Translating user intent into physical radio signals is the last critical step in wireless prototyping. It chains protocol planning, baseband synthesis, and hardware configuration. Large language models and multi-agent systems have reshaped software engineering, raising the question of whether they can solve this problem. Yet current models fail at this task, even when augmented with domain tools. Because the stages run sequentially, an error at any stage propagates downstream, so the end-to-end success rate collapses toward zero even when each stage looks locally competent. We introduce RadioMaster, a fully autonomous multi-agent framework that drives user input to verified emissions transmitted over the air. It rests on three synergistic pillars. RadioWiki grounds generation in domain knowledge to suppress hallucination. RadioAgent decomposes the fragile pipeline into independently executable and locally recoverable stages. RadioEmulator gates deployment behind closed-loop physical-layer verification. We further build RadioBench, the first benchmark for autonomous radio signal generation. Extensive real-world evaluations show that RadioMaster substantially outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in configuration viability and signal fidelity, while reducing configuration time by up to 28x.

AI.title_translation: RadioMaster：用于自主无线电信号生成的多智能体系统

title: Neural Networks Provably Learn Spectral Representations for Group Composition
comments: Add further remarks on the theoretical results and correct a minor technical flaw in the proof
summary: Understanding how structured internal structure emerges during neural network training is central to the study of deep learning. We investigate this phenomenon through the group composition task, where a two-layer neural network is trained to predict $g_1 \star g_2$ for elements of a finite group $G$. By lifting the projected gradient flow to the Fourier domain, we demonstrate that the training dynamics are governed by a Riemannian gradient ascent on a representation-theoretic energy functional. We prove that, under random initialization, this flow drives each neuron to converge almost surely toward a single irreducible representation, while the cross-layer Fourier coefficients achieve a rotational rank-one alignment. This framework provides a representation-theoretic account of feature learning and characterizes a novel low-rank compression phenomenon for matrix-valued group representations. Moreover, for Abelian groups, we provide a complete population-level description: random initialization promotes uniform diversification across nontrivial representations and induces Haar-uniform phases, jointly approximating the indicator via a majority-vote mechanism. We further prove that both phase alignment and representation competition emerge with exponential convergence rates.

AI.title_translation: 神经网络可证明地学习群组合的谱表示

title: KletterMix: Climbing Toward High-Quality German Pretraining Data - The Full Report
summary: High-quality pretraining data is a central ingredient in modern language models, but German-language resources remain far less developed than their English counterparts: they are often smaller, less carefully curated, weakly documented, and rarely validated through controlled training experiments. We introduce KletterMix, a high-quality German corpus for language model pretraining and annealing, designed as a reusable dataset artifact for the natural language processing and modeling community. KletterMix is built by translating a state-of-the-art English pretraining corpus into German while preserving document boundaries, metadata, source structure, and topical diversity. This construction yields a German corpus with the scale and diversity of a modern pretraining dataset, while enabling direct comparison to its English source. We document the dataset through a broad set of corpus-level analyses, including translation quality, document length distributions, topic coverage, source composition, and geographic metadata. Using COMETKiwi, we show that the translated documents achieve strong quality across diverse domains, suggesting that careful translation can preserve much of the semantic and stylistic richness of the original corpus. Beyond dataset construction, we evaluate KletterMix as training data. Through controlled pretraining and annealing ablations against established German corpora, we show that models trained on KletterMix achieve measurable improvements on German-language downstream evaluations. These results demonstrate that carefully curated translated data can substantially strengthen the German pretraining data ecosystem.

AI.title_translation: KletterMix：迈向高质量德语预训练数据——完整报告
AI.tldr: KletterMix是一个高质量的德语语料库，通过翻译最先进的英语预训练语料库构建，并在受控训练实验中证明其能显著提升德语语言模型在下游任务上的性能。

AI.conclusion: 精心策划的翻译数据可以极大地增强德语预训练数据生态系统。
AI.translation: 高质量的预训练数据是现代语言模型的核心要素，但德语资源的发展远不如英语资源：它们通常规模较小、管理不够精心、文档不完善，并且很少通过受控训练实验进行验证。我们引入了KletterMix，这是一个用于语言模型预训练和退火的高质量德语语料库，旨在作为自然语言处理和建模社区可重用的数据集工件。KletterMix通过翻译一个最先进的英语预训练语料库为德语而构建，同时保留了文档边界、元数据、源结构和主题多样性。这种构建方式产生了一个具有现代预训练数据集规模和多样性的德语语料库，同时能够直接与其英语源进行比较。我们通过一系列广泛的语料库级别分析来记录数据集，包括翻译质量、文档长度分布、主题覆盖范围、来源构成和地理元数据。使用COMETKiwi，我们表明翻译后的文档在不同领域都达到了很高的质量，这表明细致的翻译可以保留原始语料库大部分的语义和风格丰富性。除了数据集构建，我们还评估了KletterMix作为训练数据。通过与现有德语语料库进行受控预训练和退火消融实验，我们表明使用KletterMix训练的模型在德语下游评估中取得了可衡量的改进。这些结果表明，精心策划的翻译数据可以显著增强德语预训练数据生态系统。
AI.summary: 该论文介绍了KletterMix，一个高质量的德语预训练语料库，旨在解决德语语言模型预训练数据不足的问题。KletterMix通过翻译先进的英语语料库并保留其结构和多样性而构建。通过全面的语料库分析和受控训练实验，研究表明KletterMix的翻译质量高，并能显著提升德语语言模型在下游任务上的性能，证明了精心翻译数据对德语预训练生态系统的重要性。
